prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, shows a suburban street intersection during a clear, sunny day. The sky is a vibrant blue, and the surroundings feature multi-story residential buildings with light-colored facades and balconies. Trees with lush green foliage line the sidewalks, adding to the suburban ambiance. On the left side of the road, traffic flows in one direction, with a blue car driving away from the intersection. A silver SUV on the right side of the road is preparing to make a left turn, with its left rear turn signal illuminated. The road markings include straight and right-turn only lane markers, stop lane markers, and a stop sign. The camera remains stationary, capturing the movement of the vehicles as they navigate the intersection. The silver SUV begins to move forward along a slightly curved path, while a pale gray SUV enters the intersection from the right and moves onto the left side of the road. The scene is framed by a beige building with a flat roof on the right and a parking lot with several parked cars. The overall setting is calm and orderly, with no significant changes in the environment throughout the sequence.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, approaching an intersection in a suburban neighborhood under a clear blue sky. The road is marked with double yellow lines and features a stop lane marker painted on the asphalt. To the right, there is a house with a well-maintained hedge, and a stop sign in front of it, with a parked car on the street. A white car is seen turning right at the intersection, heading down the street. On the left side of the road, there is a red brick wall and another parked car. The background shows overhead utility poles with wires crisscrossing the sky, and some bare trees line the streets, indicating it might be late fall or early spring. The scene is calm and typical of a residential area. As the video progresses, the white car exits the frame, revealing more of the intersection and the surrounding residential area. The ego vehicle comes to a stop, yielding to an oncoming vehicle while waiting to turn right. The background scenery of houses, trees, and utility poles remains consistent, with the lighting suggesting that the sun is still high, maintaining the bright and clear conditions observed in the initial frame. The overall atmosphere remains calm and typical of a suburban neighborhood.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle driving on a multi-lane highway under a clear blue sky with a few scattered clouds. The road is marked with white lane dividers and directional arrows indicating forward and right turns. On the left side, there is a grassy area with small trees and utility poles, while the right side features a metal guardrail bordering a field of tall grass. In the distance, a large white truck is visible, traveling in the same direction as the camera. As the video progresses, the truck approaches an intersection where it is suddenly hit by a high-speed sedan coming from a perpendicular direction. The impact sends debris flying across the road, and both vehicles are visibly damaged. The camera captures the aftermath from a slightly elevated perspective, emphasizing the sudden collision and the resulting chaos.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a multi-lane highway under a clear blue sky dotted with scattered clouds. The road is bordered by dense green hedges on the left and a mix of trees and grassy areas on the right. A silver minivan is visible on the left side of the frame, partially in view, indicating it is traveling alongside the camera-equipped vehicle. In the distance, a few palm trees stand out against the horizon. As the video progresses, a motorcyclist wearing a helmet and riding a red motorcycle enters the frame between the minivan and the ego vehicle, quickly merges into the lane next to the minivan, and accelerates smoothly, moving further away from the camera. The motorcyclist continues along the highway, maintaining a steady pace. By the final frame, the motorcyclist has moved significantly further down the road, leaving the minivan behind, while the scene retains its tranquil, open-road atmosphere.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle driving on a snowy highway. The road is covered in a layer of snow, with tire tracks visible, indicating recent traffic. In front of the vehicle, a large truck is traveling in the same direction, its rear lights glowing red against the overcast sky. The surrounding landscape features a mix of snow-covered ground and patches of greenery, including trees and shrubs. The hills in the background are also dusted with snow, creating a serene winter scene. The sky is gray and cloudy, contributing to the overall muted and cold atmosphere. As the video progresses, the truck ahead begins to slow down and eventually veers off the main road onto the shoulder due to the slippery road, kicking up a cloud of snow and debris. The truck's movement is gradual, and it appears to be struggling slightly due to the slippery conditions. The vehicle from which the footage is being recorded continues to drive forward cautiously, maintaining a safe distance behind the truck. By the final frame, the truck has come to a stop on the shoulder, surrounded by a cloud of snow and debris.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the snowy highway and the truck's cautious maneuvering.

prompt_en: A first-person view from inside a vehicle captures a rainy street intersection under an overcast sky. The windshield is streaked with rain, and the wipers are actively clearing the water. Several cars are visible ahead, including a dark-colored sedan directly in front and others further to the left with their brake lights illuminated. Overhead traffic lights hang above the intersection, with some showing green signals while others display red. The sky is filled with thick, gray clouds, creating a gloomy atmosphere of a rainy day. Trees and utility poles line the sides of the road, and a palm tree is partially visible on the right side. The word "CLEAR" is faintly visible on the wet pavement near the center of the frame. As the video progresses, the car drives across the intersection under green lights. The windshield wipers continue to clear the rain, revealing more of the wet road and the vehicles ahead. The left turn arrow is red. Other vehicles pass by on the left side, their headlights glowing as they move away. The scene remains consistent with the overcast sky and wet conditions throughout the frames. By the final frame, the ego vehicle is moving into the intersection. The windshield wipers continue to work, and the wet road reflects the surrounding environment. The vehicles ahead are also moving on their respective paths, and the overall scene retains its gloomy, rainy ambiance.

prompt_en: A first-person perspective video shot from inside a car captures a sunny urban street intersection. The scene is framed by a large, domed building with classical architecture and columns on the left, and a well-maintained grassy area with tall palm trees in the center, adding a touch of greenery. Several parked cars line the streets on both sides, and the sun is high in the sky, casting long shadows across the road. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle yields to a silver car entering from the right, driving towards the intersection and then continuing straight ahead, exiting the frame towards the left. After yielding, the ego vehicle turns left at the intersection. The final frame shows the intersection without the silver car, with the domed building and palm tree still featured, and the sun continuing to shine brightly overhead. The video has a naturalistic style, capturing the everyday movement of traffic in a sunny urban setting. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, positioned at an intersection during early evening, as indicated by the soft, fading light and long shadows. The sky is a gradient of light blue to a softer hue near the horizon, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The intersection is framed by tall evergreen trees and a mix of deciduous trees, suggesting a suburban or semi-rural area. A two-story building with a flat roof and a chimney is visible on the right side of the frame, adding to the residential feel. Several cars are parked along the sides of the road. A black SUV is crossing the intersection in front of the camera, moving from left to right. Traffic lights are visible above the intersection, showing green signals. The road markings are clearly visible, and the overall atmosphere is calm and quiet.  As the video progresses, the black SUV continues moving across the intersection, gradually moving further away from the camera's perspective. The camera captures the SUV's rear as it exits the frame. Then, the ego vehicle makes a left turn while the traffic signal displays a green arrow for left-turning. A black vehicle is seen after the ego vehicle turns left and traffic signals with a red light. By the final frame, the SUV has fully crossed the intersection, the ego vehicle has turned left, and the focus shifts slightly to show the road ahead and the approaching black vehicle, maintaining the serene and orderly flow of traffic.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a modern urban setting. The road stretches straight ahead, divided by double yellow lines in the center. To the right, a large blue-and-white bus is moving forward, while a white SUV is positioned directly ahead of the ego vehicle. The surrounding architecture includes tall buildings with reflective glass facades, one of which has a distinctive curved design. The sky is clear and bright, suggesting a sunny day. As the video progresses, the traffic light remains green. The white SUV proceeds through the intersection, making a left turn. A clearly marked left-turn-only lane is visible, confirming that the ego vehicle is also in a left-turn-only lane, bordered on the right by a single white line. Crosswalk markings can be seen in the distance as well. The scene captures the dynamic movement of vehicles and the bustling urban environment, emphasizing the flow of traffic and the architectural details of the cityscape.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a quiet street intersection. The road stretches ahead, marked with white lines and stop lane markers painted on the asphalt. Two octagonal red "STOP" signs are situated on either side of the lane. Surrounding the intersection are trees with lush green foliage, casting shadows across the pavement. In the background, a large multi-story building with a mix of beige and reddish-brown tones stands prominently, suggesting it could be an office or institutional structure. The sky above is clear and blue, indicating a sunny day. The area around the intersection is landscaped with patches of grass and gravel, and there are a few streetlights visible along the sides of the road. A yellow traffic sign can also be seen further down the street. As the video progresses, the ego car is slowly approaching the intersection. The camera remains fixed, capturing the gradual advance of the vehicle towards the stop lane markers painted on the road. The surrounding environment remains largely unchanged, with the trees swaying slightly in the breeze and the large building in the background remaining static. The stop signs and streetlights continue to stand in their positions, and a white sedan can be seen approaching at the intersection from the opposite side of the ego vehicle. The overall scene conveys a sense of calm movement as the car navigates the intersection. By the final frame, the car has moved closer to the intersection, with the stop lines more prominent and the building still visible in the background.  A medium shot from the driver's perspective, capturing the approach to the intersection with a steady camera angle.

The vehicle starts at a moderate speed, gradually accelerating as it nears the stop sign. The intersection is marked with a prominent hexagonal red all-way stop sign on a pole to the left, accompanied by a pedestrian crossing with white stripes. Several pedestrians are seen walking, standing, or crossing the street; notably, one person in a pink jacket walks across the crosswalk. To the right, a building with a red facade advertises "HI-Life BBQ" and "Special Lunch," with a white van parked nearby. The surrounding area includes parked cars, utility poles with overhead wires, and a mix of modern and older-style buildings in the background. The atmosphere is calm and typical of a small town or suburban setting, with clear blue skies and sunlight casting shadows on the ground.  As the video progresses, the white car on the right remains largely static, with minimal changes in the positions of the pedestrians and vehicles. A gray SUV enters the frame from the right side, adding slight movement to the scene. The individuals using the crosswalk continue their movement, while others stand near the "HI-Life BBQ" establishment. The white van parked next to the restaurant remains stationary throughout the sequence. The environment, including the clear blue sky and the urban backdrop, stays consistent, emphasizing the tranquil and uneventful nature of the moment. By the end of the video, the scene continues to depict the same intersection with two vehicles moving, maintaining the calm and typical urban setting.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a suburban street during early evening. The road is lined with houses on both sides, featuring various architectural styles and colors, including beige, gray, and red. Trees of different types and sizes are scattered throughout the neighborhood, some with lush green foliage while others appear more sparse. A white van is parked near one of the houses on the left side of the street, and a red car is visible further down the road on the right side. The street has a "STOP" marking painted on it, and a stop sign is visible at an intersection ahead. Utility poles with wires crisscross above the street, adding to the suburban feel. As the video progresses, the camera remains fixed on the street ahead, where the ego vehicle slows down and yields to a woman holding a phone and a girl crossing in front of it at a T-intersection. The environment remains static, with no significant changes in the positions of other vehicles. The stop lane marking on the road and the stop sign remain prominent, serving as focal points for the viewer's attention. By the end of the video, the scene continues to depict the same suburban street with the white van having passed by, and the overall environment remains unchanged.

prompt_en: A dashcam captures a serene drive through a suburban area on a partly cloudy day. The road stretches ahead, bordered by lush green grass and tall evergreen trees, with deciduous trees providing shade along the way. Houses are visible on the left, nestled among the trees. The road surface shows signs of wear, with visible cracks and patches. A dog walks ahead, positioned slightly off-center in the middle of the road. The ego vehicle maintains a steady pace, keeping a safe distance from the dog. The sky is partly cloudy, allowing dappled sunlight to filter through. A wide-angle shot from within the vehicle.

The road is lined with lush green trees and houses with various colored roofs, including red and beige. Several cars are parked along the sides of the street, including a white sedan on the left and a cream SUV on the right. As the video progresses, the white sedan moves forward, indicating that the car with the camera is moving away from it. The SUV remains stationary throughout the sequence, behind which the ego vehicle is doing parallel parking. The trees sway slightly, suggesting a gentle breeze, and the overall scene remains calm and residential. By the final frame, the white sedan appears smaller, while the SUV stays put. prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a wide street scene under an overcast sky. The road stretches ahead with multiple lanes, and several vehicles are visible, including a white car directly ahead and a larger bus to the right. The bus has an advertisement for a law firm on its side. On the left side of the street, there's a parking lot filled with cars, and various commercial buildings line either side, featuring signs and storefronts. The environment suggests a suburban or semi-urban area with palm trees scattered along the sidewalks, adding a touch of greenery to the otherwise urban landscape.  As the video progresses, the vehicle continues to move forward down the street. The white car directly ahead remains in the same lane, maintaining a steady pace. The bus on the right side of the road begins to look closer to the ego vehicle, as the large size becomes more prominent while moving towards it. The advertisements, including one for a law firm, become clearer as the ego vehicle overtakes a bus stopped ahead. The surrounding environment remains consistent, with the parking lot on the left and commercial buildings on the right under the same cloudy sky.  By the final frame, both the white car and the ego vehicle move forward from the bus, making it out of the frame, and the white car slightly turns right, with its right blinker on, continuing to show the same street with the same vehicles and surroundings, maintaining the calm and steady pace of the journey.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a suburban street intersection under clear blue skies. A white SUV is stopped at the crosswalk, facing right, while a large white delivery truck is positioned to its front left, also waiting to proceed. The road curves gently to the right, bordered by sidewalks and residential houses with variously colored roofs and fences. Trees line the streets, adding greenery to the scene. A pedestrian wearing dark clothing is crossing the street near the right side of the frame, moving away from the camera's perspective. A "No U-Turn" sign is visible on the right side of the road, indicating traffic regulations for the intersection.  As the video progresses, the ego vehicle begins to move forward, slowly advancing through the intersection. The delivery truck remains stationary, maintaining its position to the front left of the SUV. The pedestrian continues their crossing, moving further down the sidewalk towards the right side of the frame. The ego vehicle turns right after a pedestrian crosses the street. During this turn, the reflection of nearby trees becomes visible on the hood of the ego vehicle. The camera angle remains fixed, capturing the gradual movement of the vehicles and the pedestrian as they navigate the intersection. The surrounding environment, including the trees, houses, and road markings, remains static throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the SUV has moved further into the intersection, while the pedestrian has almost reached the far side of the street. The delivery truck still waits in the front left of the SUV, and the "No U-Turn" sign remains prominently displayed. A speed limit of 25 is also indicated both on a sign board at the right side of the road and painted directly onto the surface of the road.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from inside a vehicle driving on a multi-lane highway under a clear blue sky. The dashboard of the car is visible at the bottom of the frame, reflecting the road ahead. The road stretches forward with multiple lanes, bordered by trees on both sides, suggesting a suburban or semi-rural area. On the left side of the highway, there’s a concrete barrier separating the lanes, and beyond it, additional vehicles can be seen traveling in the same direction. The right side of the road features more trees and some greenery. The sun is positioned high in the sky, casting bright light across the scene and creating a lens flare effect that slightly obscures the upper left corner of the frame. As the video progresses, the scene remains consistent, with the vehicle continuing its journey along the multi-lane highway. The dashboard reflects the road ahead and the surrounding environment, including the trees and other vehicles. There are no significant changes in the positions or actions of the objects; the vehicles maintain their steady pace. The sun continues to shine brightly, maintaining the lens flare effect in the upper left corner of the frame. By the end of the video, the ego vehicle gradually changes to the adjacent right lane on the highway, surrounded by the same trees and vehicles, and the sun continues to cast its bright light over the landscape. A steady, forward-moving shot from a first-person perspective.

The street is lined with houses featuring various architectural styles, including brick and siding facades. Well-maintained lawns and trees, including a prominent large tree on the left, surround the houses. Several cars are parked along the sides of the road, including a white van and a silver SUV near the foreground. A white sedan is seen driving away from the camera. Traffic cones are placed on the right side of the road, indicating ongoing construction or maintenance work. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle makes a U-turn on the residential street, and the white van and SUV initially parked on the right side of the road move out of the frame. The traffic cones remain in place, marking their designated area, while the surrounding environment, including the houses, trees, and parked vehicles, stays largely unchanged throughout the sequence. By the end of the video, the scene remains consistent with the initial frame, showing the same suburban street lined with houses, trees, and parked cars under a partly cloudy sky. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a suburban neighborhood during early evening. The car's dashboard reflects the street ahead, capturing a serene suburban scene. Across the street, a pedestrian in dark clothing is crossing the road, moving from left to right. The houses lining both sides of the street are two-story structures with neutral-colored exteriors, some featuring white picket fences. Several cars are parked along the curb, including a blue sedan. Palm trees are scattered throughout the neighborhood, adding a touch of greenery. The sky is clear with a gradient of colors suggesting a sunset, enhancing the tranquil suburban atmosphere. As the pedestrian continues their crossing, a white car moves forward towards the frame on the left lane and moves over the "STOP" lane marking on the road while the ego car remains stationary. The pedestrian's pace is consistent, and they appear focused on reaching the other side of the road. The surrounding environment remains unchanged, with the same houses, parked cars, and palm trees visible throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the pedestrian has almost reached the far side of the street, with the ego car slightly turned to the left and the overall scene maintaining its serene suburban ambiance. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the pedestrian's movement across the road.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle traveling on a multi-lane highway under a clear blue sky. The road is bordered by dense green trees on both sides, creating a tranquil environment. Several vehicles, including a prominent white semi-truck and various cars, are visible ahead, maintaining a steady pace. The highway features multiple lanes separated by concrete barriers, and the scene is bathed in bright sunlight, indicating a clear day. As the video progresses, a large amount of debris suddenly appears on the lane ahead. With little time to avoid it, the ego vehicle has to drive over the debris and continue moving forward. A noticeable jolt occurs as the ego vehicle passes over the scattered objects.  A point-of-view shot from inside the vehicle, capturing the road ahead and the surrounding environment.

The street is lined with houses on both sides, featuring different architectural styles and colors, including brick and siding. Trees with green foliage line the sidewalks, and utility poles with wires run along the street. As the ambulance continues to drive down the street, the ego vehicle changes to the adjacent left lane, and the white vans cross in the opposite lane. The ambulance maintains its steady pace, driving straight ahead. The surrounding environment remains unchanged, with the houses, trees, and utility poles continuing to stand still. The scene concludes with the ambulance moving further down the road, and the overall atmosphere remains tranquil and uneventful.  A point-of-view shot from inside a vehicle, capturing the ambulance driving down the residential street. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the ambulance as it moves away. The scene transitions smoothly as the ego vehicle changes lanes, providing a dynamic perspective of the street and the passing vehicles. The background features a mix of houses, trees, and utility poles, creating a serene suburban setting.

The street is lined with mature trees, their branches casting shadows across the road, suggesting a sunny day. On the left side of the road, there's a white car parked near a sidewalk. Two cyclists appear on the left side of the road, riding past the ego vehicle, while a white sedan drives towards the camera from the opposite direction. The cyclists continue down the street, and the sedan passes by, revealing more of the residential area with parked cars and houses. The trees continue to cast shadows, and the clear blue sky persists throughout the scene.  A point-of-view shot from within a moving vehicle, capturing the road ahead and the surrounding suburban neighborhood. The camera angle provides a first-person perspective, emphasizing the motion and the environment as the vehicle navigates the intersection and continues down the street. The scene is bathed in natural sunlight, highlighting the details of the road markings, the parked cars, and the lush greenery of the trees. The overall atmosphere is calm and orderly, typical of a quiet suburban setting.

prompt_en: A video captured from inside a car, likely using a dashboard camera, shows a two-lane suburban street during late afternoon or early evening. The road is marked with a white dashed line down the center, and several cars are visible ahead, including a silver sedan directly in front and a blue car to its right. Residential houses with varying roof colors and styles line both sides of the street, some with visible driveways and parked vehicles. Trees, some bare, suggest it might be autumn or winter. A utility pole with wires spans across the top of the frame, and a lamppost stands near the curb on the right side. The sky is clear and blue, with the sun low, casting a golden hue over the scene. As the video progresses, the silver sedan maintains its position, while the blue car gradually moves out of view. The ego vehicle overtakes a stopped vehicle ahead, which is waiting to make a left turn, indicated by its left turn signal. The surrounding environment remains consistent, with no significant changes in the positions of other vehicles or objects. The trees and houses remain stationary, and the utility pole and lamppost continue to stand in their respective places. The lighting conditions suggest the time of day is still late afternoon or early evening, with the sun continuing to cast long shadows across the road. By the end of the video, the scene remains largely unchanged, with the silver sedan still in the same position and the blue car no longer visible. The residential houses, trees, utility pole, and lamppost maintain their positions, and the clear blue sky with the low sun continues to illuminate the suburban street. A medium shot from the driver's perspective captures the road and surrounding environment.

prompt_en: The video opens with a heavy, rainy nighttime scene viewed from inside a vehicle moving at varying speeds, looking out onto a wet, reflective street. The environment is dimly lit, with only the headlights of approaching cars and streetlights breaking the darkness. The ego vehicle stops due to turning at a T-intersection. The road is slick with rain, creating a glossy surface that mirrors the lights. A leafless tree stands prominently in the center-right of the frame, its branches stark against the gray sky. To the left, several houses are partially visible with a person walking near them, while on the right, a larger, more modern structure with illuminated windows can be seen with the camera at the same angle. Parked cars line both sides of the street, and the overall atmosphere is quiet and somber. As the video progresses, a car approaches from a distance, its headlights becoming more prominent as it gets closer. This car then passes out of view, and the scene remains largely unchanged, maintaining the same wet, reflective road and dimly lit surroundings until the final frame, which captures the same tranquil, rainy street at night.  A medium shot from inside a vehicle, capturing the wet, reflective street and the dimly lit surroundings.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a multi-lane highway under a partly cloudy sky. The dashboard of the car is visible at the bottom of the frame, indicating the perspective is from the driver's seat. A white sedan is moving on the left side of the road, and a few vehicles are seen traveling in both directions on the highway. On both sides, a tall, light brown wall or barrier runs alongside the road, in front of which a chain-link fence is visible. Beyond the fence, some greenery, including trees and bushes, is present. Overhead, power lines stretch across the sky, supported by tall utility poles. The sky is a mix of blue and white clouds, suggesting a partly sunny day. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle gradually makes a right lane change to enter a faster-moving highway lane, smoothly adjusting its position relative to nearby vehicles. The white sedan on the left continues to move forward, while the vehicles on the highway maintain a steady pace. The sky retains its partly cloudy appearance, and the surrounding environment, including the utility poles and the fence, stays static throughout the frames. There are no new objects appearing, and the actions of the existing objects remain consistent with minimal changes in their states. By the end of the video, the ego vehicle has completed the lane change, while the rest of the scene maintains its original composition.  A dynamic driving sequence captured from a first-person perspective, showcasing the transition from a slower to a faster lane on a multi-lane highway. The sky's mix of blue and white clouds adds a serene backdrop to the motion, while the stationary elements like the fence and utility poles provide a sense of stability amidst the vehicle's movement.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a wet, overcast street intersection. A silver sedan is positioned directly ahead of the ego vehicle. The rear lights of two leading vehicles are red, indicating they are stationary and waiting at the intersection ahead. To the left, another car is visible, positioned further back in the opposite lane. The traffic light above the intersection is green, allowing vehicles to proceed. The road surface is shiny and reflective, indicating recent rainfall. On the right side of the street, there's a grassy slope leading up to a modern building with glass windows. Trees and shrubs line the roadside, and the sky is filled with dark, cloudy formations, contributing to the dreary weather. As the video progresses, the traffic light remains green, and the vehicles continue to move forward at a slow pace. The silver sedan ahead eventually stops, and the ego car behind it also comes to a halt. The final frame shows the same scene, with the vehicles stopped at the intersection under the same overcast sky, the wet road reflecting the surroundings, the green lights shining, and the grassy slope and modern building still visible.  A medium shot from the perspective of the ego vehicle, capturing the intersection and the vehicles ahead.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, positioned at a traffic intersection in an urban area under an overcast sky, casting a subdued light over the scene. The intersection is marked with multiple traffic lights, all displaying red and green signals, indicating that vehicles must stop and move. On the right side of the frame, a multi-story apartment building with balconies stands prominently, accompanied by a sign that reads "Leasing." To the left, another building with a blue awning is visible, hinting at a mix of residential and commercial spaces. Several cars are parked along the sides of the road, and a few vehicles are moving while others wait at the traffic lights. The intersection is clearly marked with white lines, and the traffic lights remain red, signaling that vehicles must stop. The reflective surface of the car's hood mirrors the surrounding environment, capturing the stillness of the scene, which remains unchanged throughout the video.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, looking out through the windshield onto a suburban street. The car's hood is visible at the bottom of the frame, with a small camera mounted to the windshield. The road ahead is marked with yellow lines, and a portable warning sign "ROAD WORK AHEAD" is positioned on the right side of the ego vehicle, indicating ongoing construction activity. The street is lined with large, leafy trees that provide shade, and houses with light-colored exteriors can be seen on both sides. A white van is parked near the curb on the left of the ego vehicle. The sky above is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day. As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward along the suburban street. The portable warning sign "ROAD WORK AHEAD" remains stationary on the right side of the road, and the working zone is enclosed by traffic cones on the front right side of the road. The trees and houses remain static, providing a consistent backdrop as the car advances down the road. By the final frame, the car has moved further down the street, while the white van still remains stationary. The scene maintains its suburban tranquility, with the road markings and construction sign clearly visible throughout the journey.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a multi-lane urban street intersection under a clear blue sky with a few scattered clouds. The road markings include a "right-turn only" lane marker and a single white line, with the number 87 painted on the asphalt. A crosswalk is present at the intersection of the road, and a traffic light with a red signal is present adjacent to it. A "North 87" sign mounted on a lamppost is visible on the right side of the road, positioned after a "Detour Ahead" sign which is also attached to a lamppost. Several cars are present, including a black sedan and a white sedan, both already stopped in the adjacent lanes. In the background, there's a bridge overpass, and some greenery, including trees and grassy areas, can be seen around the intersection. A building is partially visible on the right side of the frame.  As the video progresses, the vehicle continues to move forward, capturing the dynamic motion of the car as it navigates through the intersection. The camera angle shifts slightly, providing a closer view of the road markings and the vehicles ahead. The black sedan and white sedan remain stationary, waiting for the traffic light to change. The surrounding environment, including the trees, grass, and buildings, remains static, with no significant changes in their appearance or position. By the end of the video, the scene shows the vehicles stopped at the red light, with the same urban street intersection and its elements remaining unchanged. The video captures the everyday rhythm of city life, emphasizing the steady flow of traffic and the subtle interplay between moving and stationary elements within the urban landscape.

The dashboard and windshield wipers of the ego car are prominently visible in the foreground. The street is lined with trees and buildings, illuminated by streetlights casting a soft glow over the scene. The road markings, including a crosswalk and lane indicators, are clearly visible. On the left side of the street, there's a small roundabout with a plant in the center, and a brick pillar stands near the curb. The buildings on either side of the frame appear to be residential, with windows and doors faintly lit. The overall atmosphere is quiet and calm, typical of a late-night city street. As the video progresses, the red sedan turns to the right while the traffic light remains red. The surrounding environment remains unchanged, with the streetlights continuing to illuminate the area and the trees and buildings maintaining their positions. No new objects appear, and no significant actions like collisions occur apart from the movement of the vehicles. By the final frame, the scene remains consistent, with the ego car still moving in the same lane and the same red sedan turning right at the red traffic light, the same streetlights illuminating the area, and the same residential buildings and trees lining the street.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from inside a vehicle driving down a snow-covered urban street during a heavy snowfall. The windshield is speckled with snowflakes, and the road ahead is lined with various commercial establishments, including a prominent McDonald's sign on the left side. To the right, a large billboard displays the word "SOLNIX" in bold letters. Further down the road, a multi-story building is visible, partially obscured by the falling snow. The sky is overcast, casting a gray hue over the entire scene. As the vehicle moves forward, the snow continues to fall steadily, accumulating on the windshield and the road. The road ahead has been driven over by vehicles, leaving clear tire tracks, and appears very muddy and slushy. The video concludes with the vehicle still traveling down the snow-laden street, the snowflakes still actively falling, and the urban landscape enveloped in a blanket of white.

A vibrant, advertisement-covered bus is also seen traversing the street from the right side, adding dynamic motion to the scene. The sky is clear and brightly lit, casting sunlight from the left, emphasizing the sunny day. The urban setting remains consistent, with no significant changes in the environment or weather conditions throughout the video.

prompt_en: The video opens with a first-person perspective from inside a car, situated at an intersection in a suburban neighborhood. The road is lined with trees; on the left, a dense cluster of dark green trees stands tall, while on the right, lighter green trees with patches of grass and a sidewalk bordered by a low wall are visible. Several orange traffic cones are strategically placed along the center of the road, signaling ongoing construction or maintenance work. In the background, a white building with a flat roof can be seen on the right side. The sky is clear with a few wispy clouds, indicating a sunny day. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle briefly shifts lanes to maneuver around the safety zone marked by the traffic cones. A person is seen standing near the right side of the road, sweeping up fallen leaves and branches scattered across the road surface. The scene captures the calm and orderly nature of the suburban setting, with the ongoing work adding a subtle dynamic element to the otherwise serene environment.

prompt_en: The video opens with a first-person perspective from inside a vehicle, capturing a busy urban intersection under a partly cloudy sky. Several cars, including a black SUV on the right and a red sedan further ahead, are positioned at a traffic light. The intersection is clearly marked with road lines and traffic signals, with buildings and trees lining the streets. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle makes a U-turn, with the red sedan ahead turning left and its left blinker illuminated. The black SUV speeds forward, creating a dynamic shift in the scene. The surrounding environment remains consistent, with the same buildings and trees visible, but the movement of the cars adds a sense of motion and activity. By the final frame, the ego vehicle has completed the U-turn, and the red sedan is no longer in view, indicating successful navigation through the busy area.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, positioned at an intersection in a suburban neighborhood. The scene is framed by the car's dashboard and windshield, which reflect the bright sunlight and the surrounding environment. The street is lined with houses, some featuring white picket fences and others with more modern designs. Trees with sparse foliage, indicative of late autumn or early spring, line both sides of the road, casting shadows across the asphalt. A stop sign is positioned on the right side of the road. The sky above is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day. As the video progresses, the red pickup truck begins to move slowly forward, the ego vehicle stops at the intersection, yielding to the red pickup truck crossing the intersection, and then turns slightly to the right, indicating the driver's intention to proceed past the stop sign. The stop sign remains stationary, and the trees and houses continue to stand still, maintaining their positions under the clear blue sky. By the final frame, the red pickup truck has moved further into the intersection, while the rest of the scene remains unchanged.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a small town or suburban area. The car's dashboard is visible in the foreground, reflecting the surroundings on its hood. The intersection features a "clear keep" marking painted on the road, indicating traffic regulations for vehicles waiting at the light. Across the street, there is a row of buildings with a uniform architectural style, likely commercial establishments such as shops or restaurants. These buildings have a beige facade with brown roofs and large windows, giving them a classic, possibly mid-20th-century aesthetic. Trees line the sidewalks and streets, adding greenery to the scene. Several cars are parked along the sides of the road, and a few pedestrians can be seen walking near the buildings. The sky is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day. In the background, hills are visible, adding depth to the landscape.  As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward through the intersection and double yellow line markings are seen on the asphalt. The camera remains stationary, capturing the movement of the vehicle as it navigates the road. The car passes by the buildings on the left, revealing more details of their architecture and signage, and then moves towards the left. A car is parked on the right side of the ego vehicle, and a man is opening its door. The trees remain stationary, and the sky stays clear and blue throughout, maintaining the sunny weather conditions. By the final frame, the car has passed the initial intersection and turned left toward a building. The scene transitions to a quieter street lined with parked cars and more trees. The buildings on the right side of the road appear to be part of a different commercial complex, with a mix of older and newer structures. The overall atmosphere remains calm and quiet, typical of a small-town setting.

prompt_en: The video begins with a wide-angle view from inside a vehicle, capturing an intersection under a clear blue sky. The road is divided into multiple lanes, marked by white lines, and features traffic signals above. Several cars are present, including a silver SUV positioned in the opposite lane. To the right, a few vehicles are waiting to cross the intersection. The scene is set in what appears to be a suburban or urban area during the daytime. As the video progresses, a silver sedan approaches the intersection from a perpendicular direction. The silver SUV, which was initially in the opposite lane, starts to move forward. The sedan collides with the SUV, causing it to flip over and land on its roof. Debris scatters across the road as the vehicle's body parts are visibly damaged. The car remains overturned for a moment, showing the aftermath of the crash with the car still on its roof amidst the debris. The front end of the silver sedan is also clearly shown to be heavily damaged.

As the video progresses, the ego vehicle cautiously approaches the back of the bus, as the left-side door begins to open.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, approaching an intersection under a clear blue sky. The scene is framed by a row of tall evergreen trees lining the left side of the ego vehicle, casting dappled shadows over the asphalt marked with double yellow lines. On the left, a building with a sign reading "a 3080" is partially visible, surrounded by lush greenery. To the right, a construction zone enclosed by traffic cones and a temporary wall is prominent. Several vehicles are seen passing from right to left across the frames. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle moves forward, slows down, and comes to a stop to prepare to make a right turn. The traffic light on the right side shows a green light, signaling to traffic on the left that it is safe to pass. The camera angle shifts subtly, revealing more of the surroundings, including additional trees and buildings in the distance. The final frame captures the car stopping at the red light, with the construction site still visible on the main vehicle's right, and the road ahead clear and open.

The road is marked by double yellow lines down the center and white lane markings on either side. Bare trees line the left side of the road, while a grassy area is visible on the right. Due to the heavy fog and the distance, the traffic light colors appear faint and are difficult to distinguish. By the final frame, the scene remains consistent with the initial view, emphasizing the stillness and quiet of the foggy road. A wide-angle shot captures the entire road and surrounding environment, highlighting the serene yet mysterious ambiance created by the fog.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, as it drives down a residential street. The street is lined with parked cars on both sides, featuring a mix of sedans and SUVs. On the left side, there are modern houses with light-colored siding, while the right side showcases older-style homes with pitched roofs and varied exterior colors. Tall palm trees are scattered between the houses, adding a tropical feel to the neighborhood. The sky is clear and bright, indicating a sunny day. The scene is calm and typical of a suburban area. As the video progresses, the car continues its steady drive down the street. A silver sedan ahead stops to wait for a black sedan in front that is performing a parallel parking. The ego vehicle slows down and stops, waiting behind the silver sedan. The parked cars remain stationary, with no noticeable movement or changes in their positions. The houses and palm trees also stay static, maintaining the tranquil suburban setting. The blue car and the motorcycle leaning against it on the right side of the street remain unchanged throughout the frames. The scene remains consistent, emphasizing the calm and unchanging nature of the neighborhood.  A steady, forward-moving shot from the perspective of the dashboard camera captures the serene suburban street, highlighting the parked vehicles and the mix of architectural styles. The palm trees sway gently in the breeze, adding a dynamic element to the otherwise still scene. The camera angle provides a clear view of the road ahead, showcasing the orderly arrangement of the parked cars and the quiet, peaceful atmosphere of the neighborhood.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle stopped at a red traffic light at an urban intersection. The scene is set under a clear blue sky with the sun shining brightly, casting a warm glow over the surroundings. The traffic light is red, indicating that vehicles must stop. Across the intersection, a multi-story building with a mix of red and white facades stands prominently. A pedestrian crossing sign is visible on the right side of the road, near a patch of dry grass and dirt, along with a "right lane ends" sign in rhombus shape. In the background, other buildings and a bridge structure can be seen, suggesting this is a busy city area. Several cars are waiting to proceed through the intersection, including a white truck and a dark-colored sedan. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle slowly approaches the intersection, yielding to other vehicles passing from the left side of the frame to the right. The scene remains consistent with the urban setting, featuring the same multi-story building, trees, and pedestrian crossing sign, while the movement of the cars adds dynamic activity to the otherwise static environment. By the end of the video, the ego vehicle moves over the pedestrian crossing marking at the right turn junction on the road, and the intersection is still active with vehicles moving in both directions, maintaining the bustling urban atmosphere. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the entire scene.

The trees continue to sway gently, and the overall scene remains calm and undisturbed.

prompt_en: A dynamic driving sequence captured from inside a car, showcasing a multi-lane highway under a clear blue sky. The road is bordered by a metal guardrail on the right and lined with trees displaying vibrant autumn foliage. A green highway sign reading "EXIT 82 A" is prominently visible ahead, guiding the direction of travel. To the left, a grassy area stretches alongside the road. The sun is high in the sky, casting bright light and creating lens flares on the windshield. As the ego vehicle navigates a gentle curve to the right, the road continues to wind through the landscape, with the surrounding trees and grassy areas remaining consistent. The scene is bathed in warm sunlight, with the lens flares persisting due to the strong backlight, adding a cinematic quality to the footage.

The road is a two-lane street with yellow double lines in the center, flanked by sidewalks on both sides. On the left side of the street, there are houses with light-colored exteriors and varying roof colors. Some houses have small yards with sparse grass and a few leafless trees, indicating it might be late fall or early spring. On the right side, similar houses line the street, with one having a dark-colored vehicle parked in front. A trash can is positioned on the right sidewalk near the foreground. Throughout the video, a group of deer crosses the road in front of the ego vehicle, and the vehicle slows down and waits until the animals have safely passed. The scene captures the serene atmosphere of a typical suburban neighborhood, with the gentle movement of the deer adding a touch of nature to the urban setting.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a two-lane road in a suburban area under an overcast sky. The road markings include a straight path, a left-turn arrow, a right-turn arrow, a stop marking, and a bicycle symbol, all clearly visible on the road surface. On the left side of the road, there is a building with a red roof, while the right side features a house with a beige exterior and a well-maintained lawn. A yellow car is driving towards the camera, moving forward as the video progresses. The car passes by the ego vehicle and then exits the frame, without making any visible turn. The ego vehicle continues moving forward and comes to a stop on the left-turn-only lane. The lane markers, STOP signs, and bicycle symbols go out of the frame as the ego vehicle halts. The environment remains consistent throughout, with reflections of trees visible on the hood of the ego vehicle as it moves forward. The video concludes with the ego vehicle coming to a halt, yielding and preparing to turn left, while the yellow car is no longer visible and the surroundings remain unchanged.

prompt_en: A video shot from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a quiet suburban street on a sunny day. The road is a two-lane asphalt road marked with yellow center lines and white edge lines. On the left side, there's a row of houses with brick exteriors and green lawns, bordered by trees providing shade. On the right side, two trash cans sit on the curb near the sidewalk, and another house with a light-colored exterior and a wooden fence is visible. The sky above is clear and blue, indicating a bright day. The hood of the car is partially visible at the bottom of the frame, reflecting the sunlight. As the car moves forward, it approaches an intersection where two speed-limit signs indicating 25 mph become visible—one near the center of the road and the other on the right side. The camera angle remains fixed, capturing the steady advance of the vehicle. The houses, trees, and trash cans on the sidewalk remain stationary, maintaining their initial positions. The road markings, including the yellow center lines and white edge lines, remain consistent throughout the frames. The sky stays clear and blue, and the sunlight continues to reflect off the car's dashboard. The scene is static except for the movement of the car itself.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video captured from inside a vehicle stopped at a quiet intersection during the day. The hood of the car, equipped with a blue camera or sensor, dominates the foreground. The intersection is marked by faded white pedestrian crossing lines and multiple lanes, with traffic lights hanging overhead. The right traffic light displays red for two lanes, while another red light is visible across the road. A diamond-shaped lane closure sign with orange and white cones is positioned on the right side. Surrounding the intersection are tall evergreen trees, some fully leafed and others bare, indicating a transitional season. In the background, a brick building resembling a school or institutional structure stands alongside a smaller, modern building with a flat roof. The sky is partly cloudy, with patches of blue visible. The car remains stationary, offering a steady view of the serene surroundings, with no other vehicles or pedestrians in sight. The video maintains a consistent perspective, capturing the tranquil atmosphere of the scene without any abrupt changes in camera angle.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle driving across the Bay Bridge in San Francisco. The iconic bridge's towering concrete towers and intricate steel cables stretch into the overcast sky, creating a dramatic backdrop. Several cars are visible ahead, including a black sedan directly in front of the ego vehicle. The road is multi-lane, and streetlights line both sides of the bridge. In the distance, the city skyline, including notable landmarks such as the Transamerica Pyramid, is faintly visible through the mist. As the vehicle continues to move forward, the black sedan remains in the same lane, maintaining its position relative to the camera. Additional vehicles appear further ahead, indicating a steady flow of traffic. The bridge's structure and the suspension cables remain prominent. By the end, the black sedan is signaling a right turn with its rear indicator and appears to be preparing to merge into the right lane.  A medium shot from within the vehicle, capturing the dynamic motion of the Bay Bridge and the surrounding urban landscape.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, showcasing the dashboard and windshield wipers in the foreground. A dark-colored SUV, likely a Tesla Model Y, is driving ahead, navigating through a roundabout. The ego vehicle slowly moves forward, following the dark-colored SUV. The road is bordered by landscaped areas with greenery and trees, and modern buildings are visible in the background. The sky is partly cloudy with patches of blue, indicating a clear day. Other vehicles, including a red car and a white sedan, are seen moving around the roundabout. The ego vehicle does not pass the stop sign on the grassy area on the right. As the video progresses, the dark-colored SUV in front of the ego vehicle continues its journey through the roundabout, turning right with its right blinker on. Additional vehicles, such as a silver car, enter the frame from the left side. The ego vehicle briefly stops to allow the two leading cars to turn onto the roundabout. The scene remains calm and orderly, focusing on the movement of the two leading vehicles merging into the lane. By the end of the video, the dark-colored SUV is still in motion, and the roundabout continues to be active with various passing vehicles.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a suburban neighborhood. The dashboard camera captures a two-lane road marked with yellow center lines. On the right side of the road, a white sedan is parked along the curb. Pedestrians are walking with dogs off the roadway, to the right of the ego vehicle. The surroundings are lush with green trees and well-maintained lawns, indicating a peaceful residential area. The sky above is partly cloudy, suggesting a bright but slightly overcast day. As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward at a consistent pace through the intersection. The white sedan initially parked on the right side of the road starts to move out of the frame. The "25" mph speed limit sign is visible on the right side of the road. Pedestrians walking with the dogs off the roadway appear on the sidewalk as the car continues its journey. The car drives past the "25" mph speed limit sign and continues along the road, passing by more houses and trees, maintaining a steady pace. By the final frame, the car has moved further down the road, with the surroundings still featuring greenery and residential buildings, though the specific details of the environment become less distinct due to the distance.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield at a quiet intersection. The road markings clearly indicate a stop sign ahead, with the word "STOP" painted on the asphalt. Several cars are present, including a white SUV and a black sedan, positioned at various points across the intersection. The surrounding area is lush with green trees and a hill in the background under a clear blue sky. A "YIELD" sign appears before a "STOP" sign, both prominently displayed on the right side of the intersection. The reflection of a nearby road object is visible on the bonnet of the ego vehicle, indicating the shininess of the surface. The scene appears calm and orderly.  As the video progresses, the ego vehicle moves forward and gradually comes to a stop near the intersection. The white SUV begins to move forward, crossing the intersection while the black sedan remains stationary. The camera's perspective shifts slightly, revealing more of the road and surroundings, including additional vehicles and road signs. The "STOP" and "YIELD" signs remain prominent throughout the sequence, emphasizing the traffic control measures in place. The "STOP" sign, which was initially in the frame, eventually moves out of the visible frame as the ego vehicle inches forward. The lush greenery and clear sky continue to frame the scene, maintaining the tranquil suburban atmosphere.  By the final frame, the white SUV has completed its movement across the intersection, and the black sedan remains in its position. The ego vehicle is preparing to make a right turn at an intersection with an all-way stop sign on the right side of the road. The yellow and black colored traffic sign with the text "AHEAD" is seen at the end. The overall scene continues to depict a peaceful, well-maintained suburban environment with minimal traffic activity.

The scene is framed with the hood and windshield wipers visible at the bottom of the frame. Several parked cars are scattered across the lot, including a white sedan on the left, a red pickup truck on the right, and others in various colors. The background features multiple houses with different roof styles, surrounded by large, leafy trees that cast shadows over parts of the parking area. A person dressed in light-colored clothing is seen walking across the parking lot from the left side towards the center-right of the frame, moving steadily and purposefully. The sky above is clear and blue, indicating a bright and calm day. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle waits for the pedestrian to cross the road. The person continues their walk, gradually moving further into the frame until they reach the right side. The overall scene remains largely unchanged, with the parked cars and trees remaining stationary, and the person's movement being the primary dynamic element.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from the top of a vehicle, looking out onto a road under construction in a rural or suburban area. The scene is set against an overcast sky, casting a muted light over the landscape. A body of water and distant hills are visible in the background. The road is partially blocked off with orange traffic cones and barriers, and a stack of yellow barriers is positioned on the right side. An ego vehicle is moving near the construction area marked with a "STOP" sign, and a worker wearing high-visibility yellow-green clothing and a white hat is standing to its right, holding a shovel and moving slightly. The worker appears to be assisting with the construction. In the distance, another worker can be seen standing near the same stack of yellow barriers.  As the video progresses, the black SUV moves forward slowly and consistently, navigating through the construction zone. The worker initially standing beside the SUV slightly turns along the side of the road, still holding the shovel. The SUV continues its movement, passing the worker, who then stops and stands near the edge of the road. Meanwhile, a white car approaches from the opposite direction, driving past the construction site without stopping. The scene remains consistent with the overcast sky and the presence of traffic cones and barriers marking the construction area. By the final frame, the black SUV has moved further away from the construction site, and the white car has passed by. The worker who was previously standing near the edge of the road is no longer visible, suggesting they may have moved out of the frame. The overall scene continues to depict the ongoing road construction activity, with the construction barriers and cones still in place and different vehicles moving cautiously around the area in both directions.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a multi-lane road under a clear blue sky. The road is lined with utility poles and overhead power lines, and there are traffic lights visible at an intersection further down the road. Several vehicles are present: a black sedan directly ahead, a white sedan and a white van to the right. The road has a speed limit sign indicating "Speed Limit 40" with a warning about a curve ahead. Trees and shrubs are visible along the roadside, adding greenery to the scene. As the video progresses, the traffic lights remain green, nearby vehicles start moving forward, and the ego vehicle shifts to the right lane, capturing the dynamic motion of the road and the surrounding environment.

prompt_en: The video opens from inside a vehicle on a crowded city street, positioned behind a line of cars on a busy urban street. The scene is set during the evening, as indicated by the dimming light and the illuminated storefronts. Cars parked on the right include a silver sedan and a white SUV. The buildings flanking the street are multi-story, with shops and restaurants visible, some adorned with signs and decorative lights. Trees line the sidewalks, adding greenery to the urban environment. The overall atmosphere suggests a lively city area, possibly a commercial district, with a mix of residential and business establishments.  As the video progresses, the camera remains stationary, capturing the slow-moving traffic ahead. The vehicles, including sedans and a bus, have their rear lights glowing red due to the congestion. The surrounding environment remains unchanged, with no significant actions or new objects appearing throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the scene remains consistent with the initial setup, showing the same vehicles and urban backdrop, with the traffic congestion persisting.

By the final frame, the car has moved further down the road, approaching another intersection where three traffic lights display a red left-turn arrow and two green circular signals, signaling the continuation of the journey through this suburban area.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a city street scene. A large public transit bus labeled "Clean Air Vehicle" is prominently visible on the left side of the frame, traveling in the adjacent left lane, moving away from the camera. The bus has a red stripe along its side. The street is lined with modern buildings, including a tall, glass-fronted structure on the right and a brick building with numerous windows on the left. Orange construction barriers partially visible on the right side of the road, are placed along the right sidewalk, indicating ongoing work. The road features a crosswalk with white stripes, and a black car is seen moving ahead of what appears to be a traffic light. The ego vehicle drives straight under the green traffic lights. The sky is partly cloudy, suggesting a bright day with scattered sunlight. As the video progresses, the bus continues to move along the same road it was traveling from the beginning. Its rear lights are illuminated, indicating it is in motion. The black car ahead also moves forward without coming to a stop at the traffic light. The surrounding urban landscape, including the modern buildings and construction barriers, remains static throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the bus has moved further down the road, and the black car is also seen moving straight, with the urban backdrop of modern buildings and construction barriers remaining consistent.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing the movement of the bus and the black car as they navigate through the intersection.

prompt_en: A nighttime urban street scene viewed from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, unfolds under a dark sky illuminated by streetlights casting a greenish hue. The road stretches ahead, marked by clear lane directions: a left-turn arrow, left-turn and straight arrows, and a right-turn arrow painted on the asphalt. On the left side, a beige building with multiple windows is partially obscured by a tree. A yellow and black traffic sign stands near the curb, indicating a curve ahead and traffic lights turning from green to yellow. The ego vehicle turns right with varying speed onto the road, where a traffic light is seen yellow with a white and black sign above it. As the vehicle moves forward, a vehicle is seen in the distance. The road markings are prominently visible, guiding traffic flow. To the right, a fire hydrant and a larger structure, possibly a commercial building with a "Walgreens" sign, are partially visible. The area appears quiet with minimal traffic, and the overall atmosphere is calm and subdued due to the late hour. The video progresses with the vehicle continuing its steady movement through this quiet, dimly lit environment, maintaining the same elements in view: the beige building, the yellow and black traffic sign, and the larger structure on the right. The streetlights continue to cast their greenish glow, and the road markings remain prominent. The scene remains largely unchanged throughout the video, with no significant actions or new objects appearing. The final frame shows the vehicle continuing its steady movement through this quiet, dimly lit environment.

The surroundings remain consistent with residential houses, parked cars, and power lines lining the street. The overcast sky continues to cast a subdued light over the entire scene, creating a calm yet slightly somber atmosphere. Despite the movement and stopping of various vehicles, the ego vehicle does not collide with any object throughout the video.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a black vehicle, positioned at an intersection marked by a stop lane marker on the road. The scene is set in a suburban area with a mix of residential houses and greenery. On the left side of the intersection, there's a dark-colored sedan parked along the curb. In front of the ego vehicle, a white sedan is stopped at the intersection, facing the opposite direction of the camera. The road features yellow lane markings and a crosswalk. Surrounding the intersection are tall trees, including evergreens and deciduous varieties, some of which have blossoms. A stop sign is visible on the right side of the intersection, and a pedestrian crossing sign is visible across the street. In the middle of the intersection, a no-left-turn sign can be seen. Exactly above it, another sign shows a one-way sign pointing to the right.  As the video progresses, the white sedan comes to a stop and then turns right. Meanwhile, the dark-colored sedan remains stationary on the left side of the intersection. A man walking with a dog on the right sidewalk behind the stop sign is visible. The surrounding trees and houses provide a consistent backdrop, with no significant changes in their appearance or position. The overall scene remains tranquil, with the actions being the movement of the white sedan and the man walking with a dog on the sidewalk. By the end of the video, the white sedan has completed its turn and is driving away down the road, while the dark-colored sedan remains parked on the left side of the intersection. The pedestrian continues walking, and the surrounding trees and houses maintain their positions, preserving the serene suburban atmosphere. The stop sign and pedestrian crossing continue to stand in place.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the intersection, emphasizing the stop lane marker, the no-left-turn sign, and the one-way sign. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the interaction between the vehicles and the pedestrian, highlighting the calm and orderly nature of the suburban setting.

The scene is set in a rural or semi-rural area under a clear blue sky with some scattered clouds. On the left side of the road, two RVs are parked, one being a white RV with "TIOGA" written on it and the other a larger RV with gray and white stripes. On the front and right sides, important traffic signs: one way sign, stop sign, and a right-turn only sign are seen along with a white utility truck, and a large sign reading "GREAT HIGHWAY 6" is visible. The road itself has a "STOP" painted on it, indicating an intersection where vehicles must come to a halt before proceeding. In the background, there are trees, and a stop sign is visible further down the road. The scene is calm, with no other vehicles or significant activity occurring.  As the video progresses, the white RV labeled "TIOGA" is stationary, slowly exiting the frame to the left. The utility truck remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining its position near the right side of the road. The "STOP" marking on the road surface stays prominent, and the surrounding environment, including the trees and stop sign, remains unchanged. The scene captures a quiet moment at the intersection, with no other vehicles or significant activity occurring.  By the end of the video, the white RV labeled "TIOGA" has fully exited the frame to the left, leaving only the utility truck and the "STOP" marking on the road. A person is seen jogging on the right, while another person is seen walking with equipment. Several vehicles are seen on the left of the camera. The utility truck remains stationary, and the rest of the scene, including the trees and stop sign, remains unchanged. The overall atmosphere continues to be calm and quiet, with no additional movement or changes in the environment.

prompt_en: A nighttime urban street scene viewed from inside a car, likely through a dashboard camera, captures a wide, well-marked road stretching straight ahead under the dark sky. Streetlights line both sides of the street, casting a soft glow over the asphalt. A blue SUV drives past on the right side, its taillights glowing red as it moves away from the viewer. The vehicle continues to drive further down the street, gradually becoming smaller in the distance. Red traffic lights are visible at the intersection ahead. The ego vehicle makes two consecutive lane changes to the right while continuing to move forward. Surrounding the street are buildings with illuminated signs, including one that reads "NOW OPEN," indicating a new business. Palm trees and other greenery are visible along the sidewalk, adding to the urban setting. The overall atmosphere is calm and quiet, typical of a late-night cityscape. As the video progresses, the SUV continues to move away, and the scene remains largely unchanged, maintaining the same elements and lighting conditions throughout the sequence.

The traffic cones remain in place, ensuring safe passage. The final frame captures the vehicle continuing its journey down the road, with the sun casting long shadows across the pavement.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide-angle shot captured from inside a vehicle at an intersection during late afternoon, as indicated by the long shadows and the position of the sun. The dashboard reflects the road ahead, with multiple traffic lights visible overhead, one of which is green for the direction the camera faces. Several cars are present, including a sedan directly ahead and others waiting at the stoplight. To the left, a "No U-turn" sign is visible. The surroundings feature trees lining the roadsides and some commercial buildings in the background, suggesting a suburban area. Power lines crisscross above the intersection, adding to the urban landscape. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle begins turning left, and the left-turn arrow light changes from green to yellow. The camera captures the 'Scott' street sign hanging from a traffic signal pole as the vehicle completes the turn. Lane merging markers become visible on the road ahead as the vehicle continues through the intersection. The scene shifts slightly, revealing more vehicles on the left side of the ego vehicle as it passes through the area.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a suburban street intersection on an overcast day. The road is marked with yellow lines and appears wet, suggesting recent rainfall. Several vehicles are present: a white sedan is stopped at the intersection, facing the camera, while a black SUV is positioned further ahead, also stationary. To the left, a silver pickup truck is stopped at the intersection, and to the right, a dark-colored SUV is parked near the sidewalk. Residential houses with various roof colors and styles line both sides of the street, with some featuring small front yards and trees. A stop sign is visible on the right side of the frame, indicating the traffic rules for this intersection.  As the video progresses, the white sedan begins to move forward, slowly crossing the intersection. The black SUV remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining its position at the center of the frame. The silver pickup truck on the left begins to move forward, and the dark-colored SUV on the right continues to stay parked, with no noticeable movement. The scene captures multiple vehicle interactions at a 4-way stop, illustrating typical right-of-way behavior. The wet road surface and overcast sky persist, contributing to the subdued ambiance of the scene. By the final frame, the white sedan has completed its crossing, and the silver pickup truck has advanced from its original position, while some other vehicles remain unchanged, maintaining the calm and quiet atmosphere of the residential area.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing the interaction between the vehicles and the stop sign.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a residential street. The road is initially marked with yellow lines down the center, indicating a two-lane street, but then it disappears. On the right side of the road, there is a white pickup truck parked near several orange traffic cones, which are placed to block off part of the street. The truck appears stationary, with a box on its bed. The reflection of the white hooded vehicle can be seen on the windshield as it passes by. A work zone is also visible on the right side of the road, clearly marked and bounded by a series of orange traffic cones. The surrounding area consists of houses with similar styles of architecture, some with visible driveways and garages. The houses are surrounded by lawns and trees, some of which are bare. The sky above is clear and blue.  As the video progresses, the white hooded vehicle moves forward, slowly clearing the area marked by the orange traffic cones. The vehicle's movement is steady and deliberate. The traffic cones remain stationary. The camera remains fixed, capturing the vehicle's departure and the gradual opening up of the road ahead, revealing more of the residential street lined with houses and trees. By the final frame, the truck has moved further down the street, a tree devoid of foliage is visible on the right, and the road is mostly clear of the traffic cones, showing a broader view of the neighborhood with fewer obstructions.
