prompt_en: A cinematic video captures a solitary individual standing on a grassy hilltop under a dramatic sky filled with layers of clouds. The person, positioned centrally on a narrow, upright trapezoidal pedestal, is shown in a low-angle wide shot, emphasizing their isolation and the expansive nature around them. The camera initially faces the front of their body from a diagonal view on their left side, then moves in a continuous arc shot, showcasing various cloud formations in the sky. The sun, initially midway in the sky, becomes visible as the camera faces the person straight on, creating a radiant glow. As the video progresses, the sun moves behind the individual, and towards the end, it disappears from the frame. The final shot shows the person slightly off-center, viewed from a diagonal angle behind them on their right side. The lighting is high-contrast, with the bright sunlight filtering through the clouds creating a radiant glow while the central figure remains silhouetted in shadow. The individual is wearing pants and a cap, with their elbows bent and hands positioned in front of their body, though further details about their appearance and posture are obscured. The sky displays a range of colors, from deep blue higher above the horizon to a bright white near the sun.

prompt_en: Two women are playing similar string instruments in a medium shot captured at eye level. Both have long, black hair adorned with pink rabbit ears headbands. They wear full-sleeved, V-neck purple shirts and partially visible black chokers. With their left hands, they hold the body of the black-stringed instrument, where the white strings are attached. The lower part of the instrument rests on their left shoulders, between the chin and the neck. Using a long, black bow, they glide over the strings, creating music with fluid, continuous movements. Their left thumb is positioned under the body of the instrument, while the rest of the fingers rest on the fretboard to play the notes. Occasionally, they shake their hands to produce a vibrato effect. Their bodies move rhythmically left and right as they play, their eyes closed in concentration. The setting is an artificial backdrop with sufficient lighting, featuring a dark orange vignette that flickers and spreads in various directions, adding a dynamic visual element to the scene.

She wears a long navy blue coat over a baby blue V-neck undershirt with large buttons, paired with blue pants. Her blonde hair falls loosely around her shoulders. The hallway is lined with doors on both sides; on the right wall, there is a white door with a black handle and a key in the lock, followed by a yellow vent. On the left wall, a gray metal door stands out. Her path is blocked by a metal-framed door with glass panels and a keycard reader. Beyond the glass panels, more white doors line the opposite wall. Bright white light streams through a large window at the end of the hallway, creating a stark contrast with the otherwise muted tones of the corridor. The setting suggests a secure or compartmentalized area. As she approaches the glass panel doors, her gaze shifts to check if they are closed, her movements fluid and uninterrupted. The camera maintains a medium shot throughout, capturing her anxious yet determined demeanor and the detailed environment of the hallway.

prompt_en: A video captures the interior of a modern transportation carriage with large panoramic windows and a sleek design. A woman with long dark hair, dressed in a red and pink striped sweater, is seated at a wooden table enjoying a meal. The table holds a bowl of food, a paper cup, and a drink bottle. The seating is upholstered in brown leather, and a wall-mounted light fixture with warm lighting illuminates the space. Shelves with framed photos adorn the right side of the carriage. Outside the large windows, an urban landscape with rail tracks, buildings, and a tree is visible, with motion blur indicating the train's movement. Additional glass panels above the windows allow natural light to flood the carriage. In the opening scene, the woman is eating, with a bowl in front of her and a utensil in hand. As the train passes by, she notices a silver train with green and orange stripes and turns her gaze outside the window. She dips the spoon into the bowl, then looks at the passing train and slightly moves her body in an up-and-down motion. As the train exits view, she slows down. The scene features random camera movement, creating an unsteady effect, and is shot at eye level, capturing the natural perspective of someone seated at the table.

prompt_en: In a casual indoor setting illuminated by natural light streaming through an open window, a man presents a towering food and drink creation on a wooden table. The focal point is a large glass filled with a burnt orange-colored beverage, serving as the base for a stacked arrangement of food items. Atop the glass sits a long bun, supporting a central stack of burgers and a piece of pickle perched on top. Thin skewers hold additional food items, including a ring-shaped food and golden-brown fried pieces. The man, wearing a black t-shirt and an army green cap, places the creation on the table with a wide grin, revealing a black and green tattoo on his arm. The camera, initially at eye level in a medium shot, pans left to focus on the food item as the man steps away. In the background, a young man in a dark gray sweater and a woman in a light gray sweater with a navy blue cuff design react with amusement; the man grins widely, while the woman places her hand on her chest and laughs dramatically. The table also holds three more glasses: one with a dark beverage, another with an orange drink and ice, and the final one containing a small, transparent liquid. The backdrop features a minimalist black-and-white wallpaper of trees framed in black, adding a serene touch to the lively scene.

prompt_en: A chef stands at a dark granite countertop, preparing a dish with precise and deliberate movements. The sequence begins with a mid-close-up shot on the countertop, focusing on the chef's gloved hands as they hold a cooked, golden-brown food item on a small orange plate. The chef, dressed in a white chef’s coat and wearing a watch on their left wrist, uses a large kitchen knife in their right hand to slice through the browned exterior of the dish, revealing a creamy, white filling intertwined with vibrant green elements inside. The camera remains mostly static but tilts slightly to the right at the beginning. As the sequence continues, the chef's movements are smooth and controlled, with the left hand stabilizing the food. After the first cut, another slice follows in the same manner, showcasing the layered textures and contrasting colors of the dish.  The camera then pans left as the chef picks up one piece of the food with their right hand and places it onto a larger orange plate situated on the left side of the countertop. They then lift another piece and carefully position it on the same plate, aligning the portions neatly. The camera zooms in slightly as the chef arranges the second piece on the plate. The chef’s movements are fluid and professional, emphasizing precision and attention to detail. The background features a warm wooden texture that complements the countertop, creating a homely and inviting atmosphere. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the golden surface of the food and the creamy white and green filling. The chef’s reflection is visible on the smooth surface of the countertop. The close-up angle emphasizes the intricate preparation process, offering a detailed view of the textures, colors, and movements. The overall setup, with its warm tones and clean presentation, presents a scene that feels structured and methodical, drawing attention to the careful preparation of the dish.

prompt_en: A scenic road journey unfolds through a mountainous landscape shrouded in low-hanging clouds. The camera, positioned outside the back right window of a blue vehicle, captures a wide shot at eye level, panning left to reveal a rugged terrain of grey and brown mountains. A reflective body of water lies beneath an imposing mountaintop, partially obscured by fluffy gray clouds. Two dirt roads are present; one in the midground on the right, disappearing behind an incline near the center, and another on a leveled portion of an incline, sloping upward to the left and downward to the right. A series of nine cylindrical objects with dark stripes line up along the side of the road furthest from the camera. A white car is visible near the body of water, appearing small in the distance. The camera follows the road in a tracking motion, highlighting the bright, white highlights on the tops of the clouds against the vivid blue sky. The scene is bathed in diffused sunlight, casting a warm glow over the dirt browns and stone grays of the landscape.

prompt_en: In a small office-like room with a mix of white and wooden walls, a man dressed in a red t-shirt and dark-colored pants stands poised with a skateboard positioned in front of him on the ground. The room features large windows covered with blinds, allowing soft light to filter in. A black desk is positioned behind the man, accompanied by a smaller black side table that holds a basketball and other miscellaneous items both on top and on its lower shelf. The man, initially standing with a focused expression, steps onto the skateboard, demonstrating his balancing skills. As he prepares to perform a trick, the camera pans to the left, then pedestals up, following his movements closely. He kicks the board up with his right foot, attempting a flip or twist, but the skateboard flips unexpectedly, causing him to lose his balance and fall towards the left wall. The man quickly regains his composure, touching the wall with his right hand, and readjusts his stance. The skateboard remains on the floor, indicating a missed trick. The casual nature of the activity is evident as the man appears unfazed. In the background, a painting and a cardboard box sit on the window ledge, along with other miscellaneous items. The room also includes an air vent diffuser and an office light on the ceiling.

prompt_en: A majestic hawk perches on a metallic platform, its white underbelly contrasting sharply with its dark brown wings and back. The bird's yellowish eyes and streaks of brown between its white breast and head feathers are prominently displayed. Clutched firmly in its talons is the tail of a fish, which it occasionally pecks at. Throughout the clip, the hawk remains mostly stationary, occasionally adjusting its head from right to left. The backdrop features a large body of brown, wind-streaked water, with dense green vegetation lining the opposite shore. The platform, smaller than the bird, is adorned with rivets and a metal pipe is visible in the bottom left corner. Trees separate the bird from the water, adding depth to the scene. The camera captures the bird in its natural environment with gentle movements, focusing on the hawk as it enjoys its meal. Sunlight bathes the scene, casting natural shadows on the vegetation and a soft glow on the bird's feathers.

prompt_en: The video captures an expansive aerial view of a picturesque coastal town, showcasing a serene and organized beachfront. Two crescent-shaped beaches are enclosed by light breakwaters, creating distinct areas for relaxation and activities. The beach on the right is bustling with several boats, suggesting recreational water sports, while the left beach is lively with people enjoying the clear blue waters. The camera maintains a wide shot at eye level, smoothly tracking left throughout the sequence.  As the video begins, a motorboat enters the frame from the bottom-left corner, gliding across the calm sea, leaving a trail of white foam in its wake. The gentle waves continue to move towards the coastline, adding a soothing rhythm to the scene. The bright daylight illuminates the entire area, casting a warm glow over the sandy beaches and the turquoise waters. The town below is neatly arranged, with rows of houses and green fields stretching outwards. A long road cuts through the middle of the town, with vehicles traveling along it, adding a sense of life and activity. The backdrop features rolling hills and lush greenery, with distant mountains and some smoke rising from the far left side, enhancing the tranquil yet vibrant atmosphere of this coastal paradise.

prompt_en: A ceremonial scene unfolds outside of an ornately decorated temple with a majestic snow-capped mountain backdrop. The temple, positioned in the center-left part of the screen, is the main focus and is adorned with cascading orange and yellow flower garlands, completely covering its walls. The edges of the temple’s roof and frames are outlined by flowers thicker than the garlands in shape, in varying hues. The rake edge of the roof is decorated by a small rectangular image with a yellow garland background, and inside it, a symbol is prominently colored by purple and maroon garlands. At the heart of the structure, there is something written in purple garland-colored South Asian script, and below it, something written in red garland-colored South Asian script, both covered by yellow flower garlands. Only the top part of the temple is visible.  Behind the temple is a tall stone structure with a trapezoidal base and blue columns supporting a ridged roof. Above the roof is a golden chattra spire. Four orange flags with two banners are hoisted atop poles with pointy metallic tips, fluttering energetically in the air and positioned in front of the temple. The poles move up and down dynamically. The background is a stunning snowy mountain range enveloping the temple. The lighting in the video is natural, casting a warm glow over the scene.  The camera makes subtle random motions, tilting up and to the right slightly, revealing more of the sky and mountain tops. The lower right side of the screen features a yellow column part of another structure decorated in yellow garlands, mirroring the temple's festive adornment. The overall scene is vibrant and lively, capturing the essence of a significant cultural or religious event against the breathtaking backdrop of nature.

prompt_en: The video showcases two rugged, off-road vehicles parked side by side in a stunning mountainous landscape. Both cars are dark green, covered in mud, and equipped with large tires. The first vehicle has black rims with a metallic border, while the second car's rims are entirely metallic. A large orange object with a textured surface and cut corners is attached to the right side of the covered cargo compartment of the first vehicle. The roof of the first car is fitted with a flat, elongated rectangular black object that spans the entire roof from the rear to the middle of the cabin.  The camera moves in a curved path to the right, capturing a wide shot from an eye-level angle, highlighting the stationary vehicles on a grassy plateau. As the camera pans, the silhouette of a man in the front seat of the first car becomes visible. Initially, his head is down, but he raises it as the camera continues to move. The front part of the second car is partially obscured by the first car. The cargo area of the second car, open on the sides, is loaded with items in black and orange. On the roof of the cargo area, another flat, elongated rectangular black object covers the entire roof above the compartment, with a small horizontal white line running down the middle.  In the background, a majestic mountain range adorned with snow-capped peaks and jagged, rocky slopes stretches wide, creating a striking contrast with the lower forests visible in the lower right corner of the frame. Puffy white clouds float above the mountains, and sunlight casts sharp shadows, enhancing the rugged textures of the vehicles and the surrounding environment.

prompt_en: A close-up shot captures a dynamic culinary moment where a gloved hand uses silver tongs to place a piece of browned meat onto a bed of glossy, yellow noodles on a hotplate. The hotplate, resting on a worn, wooden board at a slight angle towards the left, is positioned on a flat, metallic surface. The noodles, thick and curling, support a bright, uncooked egg yolk encased in a ring of semi-set egg white on the front edge of the skillet. A thick, dark sauce is poured over the meat and noodles from a round scooped object, moving in a counterclockwise motion to cover the meat completely. The sauce cascades down the sides, slightly coating the noodles, creating a sizzling interaction with the heated surface. Steam rises from the hotplate, illuminated by warm, bright light reflecting off the ingredients. The camera angle is high, providing a clear view of the action, with occasional zoom-ins and random camera movements enhancing the sense of immediacy and energy.

prompt_en: A public gathering unfolds in a spacious indoor venue, where a man with a goatee, dressed in a light-blue short-sleeved shirt and dark shorts, stands between two dark-colored sofas, addressing an audience. He holds a microphone in his right hand and gestures with his left, occasionally touching the shoulder of a woman seated on the larger sofa beside him. The woman, adorned in a colorful, floral-patterned gown and a hot pink headwrap, listens attentively. The scene is set against a large screen displaying a vibrant airplane logo and the text "4R-EXR," which changes throughout the event. The camera captures the scene in a wide shot at eye level, with slight random movements, focusing primarily on the man as he speaks and gestures. The audience, a diverse group of people in various attire, stands facing the speaker, with some looking at their handheld devices. Above, viewers on an upper level lean over a glass railing, observing the event. The venue's architecture features white walls and floors, with embedded ceiling lights and brighter illumination from the upper level.

prompt_en: A man explores an outdoor historical site with stone walls, capturing himself with a handheld camera. He stands in the center of the frame, wearing a dark blue jacket over a green T-shirt and brown sunglasses with a white logo on the top right corner of the right lens and on the right arm. A dark blue strap crosses his right shoulder, with a white logo and letters on a dark section. The man is partially turned to the right, facing the camera, and begins walking while turning his head back to the left and speaking. He then turns to the camera, looks down, and starts moving forward and upward. He continues talking briefly before opening his mouth, shifting his gaze back and forth at the path and then back at the camera as he walks. The camera follows his movements closely, revealing a curving grass path bordered by a rustic old white stone wall to the right, with several holes where pieces of stone are missing. The stone balustrade on the left is more weathered, with a yellower and browner hue, and ends at a small tower-like structure with a brown roof visible in the top center area. The background is bright and sunny with clear skies, and distant hills and tall green trees can be seen beyond the structure's walls. The ambiance is lively and dynamic, with the man's natural movements adding to the sense of exploration and discovery.

The scene opens with a woman with braided blonde hair in two pigtails, secured with black hair ties, standing amidst rugged, rocky terrain. She wears a light blue vest over a black long-sleeved shirt and an unsecured blue headgear with a black object attached to the top, along with a gray and white bandana beneath it. As she interacts with a man dressed in black, who holds a white-and-black water bottle in his right hand and an object in his left, she gently touches her hair, first her right pigtail and then her left, before turning to face the camera and continuing their conversation. The man, wearing a secured white-colored helmet with a pink bandana, initially looks at her but then shifts his gaze downward and to his left as she turns to address the camera. Afterward, he looks back at her. Behind them, another climber in a green top, scarf, and secured headgear is seen drinking from a bottle. The camera begins with random motion, gradually transitioning to a steady arc shot, focusing on a medium shot at an eye-level angle that captures the woman and her interaction with the man in black. The expansive landscape stretches out, showcasing the sharp contrasts between the rugged rocks and the serene sky. Bright natural light illuminates the scene, highlighting the details of the climbers' gear and the surrounding environment. An orange rope lies on the ground near the group, and a black metallic structure is visible to the right, adding to the sense of adventure and exploration.

prompt_en: A man harvests a vegetable in a rural garden setting. Dressed in black pants and a dark blue, long-sleeved shirt with sleeves rolled up to his elbows, he bends over to uproot a green onion or leek from a large raised black planter box. The camera captures this action from a medium shot at ground level, positioned just a few inches below his knees, and slightly angled diagonally to frame him as he reaches over. His right foot is forward, with his left hand resting on his right knee, as he grabs the vegetable's stalk. He shakes it left and right to dislodge the soil, then shakes it more vigorously to remove excess dirt from the roots. Standing up straight, he transfers the vegetable from his right to left hand. The backdrop includes a small greenhouse structure made of transparent plastic on the left and a cluster of leafless trees on the right. A green hill is visible in the distance between these elements. The scene is bathed in natural daylight, creating a serene and productive atmosphere.

prompt_en: An adult man stands on a podium, holding a bouquet wrapped in a yellow wrapper with flowers in shades of white, orange, and yellow, along with green foliage. He is dressed in a white judo gi adorned with the Chinese flag on the upper left chest side, a red symbol on his left shoulder, and a circular logo with a green symbol and text on his right shoulder. A red lanyard hangs around his neck, with a large golden medal partially obscured by the bouquet. The man maintains an upright posture, nodding slightly and shifting his gaze from slightly upward to straight ahead. The camera zooms in with a medium shot, capturing the man from the waist up, while remaining at eye level throughout the sequence. The background features a maroon backdrop with evenly spaced white rounded rectangles displaying various logos, including "SOCAR," "TODINI," "Taishan," and "France Bleu." The lighting is even, ensuring all elements in the frame are clearly visible. The upper right corner displays two overlayed logos: one with a red "O" inside a white rectangle and another with a blue, red, and green spiral design.

prompt_en: A man is maneuvering a large recliner armchair in a spacious room with beige carpeting. The camera pans right in a wide shot at eye level to capture his movements. The man is dressed in a light blue button-up shirt, baggy brown trousers, and dark brown shoes. His right profile is facing the camera. He begins by standing to the left of the dark maroon recliner and gripping its backrest and side, tilting it slightly upwards from its base. Its upholstery shines in the light, except for a tan wooden knob on the lower right half of the chair. In subsequent moments, he continues to carefully tip it forward, exposing the wooden framework and metal mechanism underneath. He maintains a steady grip as he adjusts his hands, with a screwdriver gripped in his right hand at the same time. As he carefully and deliberately rolls the recliner from upright, its position is altered from fully upright to horizontal. The man hunches over and inserts the screwdriver into the armchair frame, moving the screwdriver in and then upwards before moving his attention to the opposite side of the chair. The camera keeps its focus on the standing man, stopping its pan but shaking slightly as the man uses his screwdriver. The room is spacious and decorated with a few pieces of furniture including a striped armchair and a brown armchair, which are positioned against the walls across from each other. There is a white railing that is at the top left side of the frame, which stands next to an outcropped part of the wall. A small dark lamp on the left of the striped chair can be seen before the camera pans. Muted yellow walls with white baseboards form a corner on the right side of the frame. Behind the other brown armchair, there is a black framed picture hanging, which features indistinguishable warm hues. Two bronze-colored vases to the right of the scene rest under the frame in a wooden tray on a beige platform. A large potted plant with sparse foliage reaches past this frame.

prompt_en: A vlog-style scene captures a man enjoying a meal outdoors under a white awning. Seated on a white plastic chair against a white cinderblock wall, he holds a small wooden utensil in his right hand, bringing a brown gourd-shaped bowl to his lips. The bowl is nestled within a white and green woven outer bowl. Dressed in a black T-shirt with a spoon logo and white text, he sips the contents with evident enjoyment, his facial expressions conveying satisfaction and delight. The camera remains mostly stationary, offering a frontal view of the man and the surrounding environment. The white awning, with black bars and slats, provides shade from the bright daylight, which casts natural light and shadow across the scene. A few other patrons are seated nearby, including a person in dark pants and a white striped button-up shirt facing away from the camera. Beyond the awning, a street lined with trees and a few cars, including a white and a grey vehicle, stretches into the distance. The overall atmosphere is casual and inviting, highlighting the man's culinary experience and the relaxed outdoor setting.

prompt_en: A sleek white Audi sports car is captured driving through a dimly lit underground parking garage. The car, with its low-profile and wide rear design, glides smoothly past two large concrete pillars. The glossy white exterior reflects the ambient light, accentuating its sporty lines. The rectangular rear lights glow a striking red, and a black rear spoiler adds to its aggressive stance. The license plate, bordered in black, displays a combination of letters and numbers in white text. The rear bumper features two black exhaust outlets, and the side panels include large black air intakes. The black wheels reflect the faint light, adding to the car's polished appearance.  As the car moves forward, it passes between the pillars, turning left and then continuing straight. The camera follows the car in a wide shot, panning to the left to keep the vehicle centered. The angle remains at ground level, focusing on the rear and left side of the car. The taillights glow more prominently towards the end of the clip, and the car slows down while moving forward. The parking garage has an industrial feel, with exposed concrete beams and pipes on the ceiling and plain, dark walls in the background. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting faint shadows around the structural elements.

prompt_en: A person is preparing ingredients for cooking, focusing on crushing garlic cloves inside a mortar. The video begins with a close-up shot of the person's left hand picking up several garlic cloves from a wooden cutting board and placing them into a dark gray mortar. The person, wearing a gold ring on their right ring finger, then uses a pestle with their right hand to crush the garlic, applying an up-and-down motion with slight rotation. The camera remains steady, capturing the detailed action of the hands and the mortar. As the person continues to crush the garlic, another hand briefly enters the frame from the right, moving across the top of the cutting board. The background is well-lit, showcasing the rough texture of the mortar and pestle on the left side of the frame. On the right, the wooden cutting board holds various ingredients, including white, green, and light purple items, neatly arranged into two piles. A white bowl with a red and green floral pattern contains a mix of light and dark brown circular pieces. The background also includes a black textile material and a small patch of red, adding contrast to the scene. The overall setting is natural, with earthy tones dominating the visual palette.

prompt_en: In a medium shot at eye level, two young women stand side by side in an outdoor setting, framed by a large white metal panel with rust patches and a textured surface. The woman on the left sports two high twisted buns atop her head, with her long, shiny brown hair cascading down in smooth curls. She wears a glossy black outfit with a high neckline and a cutout design just above the chest, revealing her skin. Her makeup includes red lipstick and black eyeliner with a small winged effect. The woman on the right has her hair tied back in a thick braid that drapes over her shoulder, with a few loose strands framing her face, which moves slightly in the wind. She is dressed in an unbuttoned white collared shirt under a black vest, paired with a loose black tie.  The two women face each other initially before turning to look at the camera. Their expressions are serious; their eyebrows are furrowed, and there are light wrinkle lines at the center of their foreheads. The woman on the left has her mouth slightly open, showing her teeth, while the woman on the right lifts her left hand, flicks something out of it, and then lowers it, tilting her head slightly to the right. They both shift to the left and move toward the camera, gradually becoming out of focus as the video concludes. The scene is well-lit with natural sunlight, casting sharp shadows and overexposing parts of their faces. In the background, a dark interior of a tall structure is visible on the right, with items leaning against a vertical pillar.

prompt_en: An aerial landscape video showcases a breathtaking mountainous region covered in snow. The camera slowly zooms in, revealing a charming village nestled within the snowy peaks. The landscape is dominated by vast expanses of white snow, with patches of brown earth visible, highlighting the rugged terrain. The village consists of closely packed, rectangular houses with flat roofs and earth-toned exteriors, blending seamlessly with the natural surroundings. The structures vary in size and elevation, following the contours of the mountainous landscape. Winding roads carve through the hills, creating a serpentine pathway that connects the scattered houses and the main area of the settlement. These roads twist and turn, leading to various parts of the village. Cars are parked along both sides of the roads, adding a touch of life to the otherwise tranquil scene. The sky is a vibrant, clear blue, providing a striking contrast against the pristine white snow and the warm, earthy tones of the exposed ground. The sunlight reflects off the snow-covered terrain and the rooftops, enhancing the natural brilliance of the scene. The overall ambiance is serene and tranquil, capturing the beauty of this picturesque mountainous setting.

prompt_en: In a bright and airy kitchen, a cheerful woman demonstrates a culinary process, standing at a wooden table adorned with two large bouquets of wildflowers in vases. She is wearing a floral pink blouse with wide sleeves and a white apron with a grey lining. Her blonde hair is loosely tied behind her neck, with some strands falling gently over her shoulders. The woman is actively engaged in her task, using her hands to explain and gesture towards the camera, maintaining a friendly and enthusiastic demeanor. The table is set with various baking essentials: cake tins, a large blue plate filled with strawberries, a jar of jam, eggs in a wire basket, and other ingredients. A green potted herb sits on the left side of the table, adding a touch of freshness to the scene. The kitchen is spacious, with large window panes allowing ample natural light to flood in, and the background features additional plants and kitchen appliances, slightly out of focus. The video captures the woman's movements and expressions in a medium shot, emphasizing her interaction with the camera and the ingredients on the table.

prompt_en: A modern laptop rests on a round, mint-green table within a minimalist interior setting. The video begins with a medium shot from a high angle, introducing a wider view of the room. On the left side of the frame, a round, vertical, golden pole extends upward, with a circular ring and three smaller cylinders forming its base. To the right, a low, circular, mint-green table supports a white Dell laptop. The camera pans right to bring the device into focus at the center of a close-up shot. The laptop is open, showcasing a sleek, white keyboard and a thin, white-trimmed screen displaying a scenic waterside wallpaper in hues of purple, blue, and yellow. The wallpaper features rocks in the foreground, calm waters, a distant peak, and a colorful sky. A small, gray icon is visible at the top-left corner, with a black taskbar containing app widgets below the display. The brand name "Dell" is written in rose gold letters beneath the screen, and a tiny, black, rounded rectangle is located below this text. The camera remains static towards the end, focusing on the laptop as it is angled slightly upward and to the right. The top of the green stand has a glossy finish, with the laptop casting a subtle shadow over it. The lighting is bright and soft, casting a warm hue over the walls and enhancing the laptop’s design features. The background alternates between a dark section and a yellow-white shade, with a narrow pipe running across the bottom. The left half of the table is positioned in front of the lighter wall, while the right half is in front of a white wall face.

prompt_en: A close-up shot of a beautifully plated dessert, showcasing a golden-brown eclair-like pastry with a delicate, crisp exterior dusted with powdered sugar. The pastry is split open, revealing perfectly piped mounds of rich, textured coffee-colored cream filling, each with velvety ridges and topped with finely chopped nuts. A small sprig of fresh green garnish adorns the rightmost swirl. Beneath the pastry, four glossy lines of dark brown sauce radiate outward in evenly spaced streaks. In the foreground, a rounded food item with a soft, velvety foamy texture, light beige in color, sits slightly overlapping the chocolate lines. The plate is a pristine white ceramic with a subtle textured pattern along its edges. The background remains softly blurred, with another golden-brown item briefly appearing on a plate on the top right side. The scene is captured under bright, natural lighting from a slightly elevated angle, gradually pulling back to reveal the intricate details of the dish.

prompt_en: A woman rides a bicycle down a quiet urban street on a cloudy day. She is dressed in a black helmet, black raincoat, black pants, and closed black shoes, riding a black bicycle with a green head tube. She pedals steadily, holding onto the handlebars, and briefly stops, then resumes her journey. As she cycles, she passes a curved road to the left and approaches two black sedan cars on the left. She turns her head slightly to the right, then looks back at the camera. The woman continues cycling under a concrete bridge and approaches more parked cars and modern buildings on the right. The back of her raincoat flutters in the wind, and the wet ground reflects the faint light, enhancing the sense of dampness and coolness. The overall tone is gray and cold, highlighting the dreary weather. The video is shot at eye level, maintaining a wide shot, and with the camera in a tracking motion, capturing the urban street scene with a concrete wall, green grass, trees, utility poles, and modern buildings on both sides. In the distance, taller industrial-style buildings and green trees complete the muted urban landscape.

prompt_en: A man is fishing, standing by a body of water with a serene backdrop of large, smooth rocks and lush greenery. He is wearing a light blue, long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his elbows, and a dark blue baseball cap adorned with a vibrant logo and black sunglasses. His body is angled to the side as he speaks with a slight smile, nodding his head twice—first to the left and then slightly to the right while shrugging slightly during the second nod. Near the end, he briefly removes his right hand from the fishing rod, making an open-handed gesture, before turning his head back to the water. The scene is well-lit with the sun casting a warm glow over the man and his surroundings. The video is captured with a medium shot at eye level, showcasing the man's casual yet focused demeanor amidst the tranquil setting.

prompt_en: The video captures a sequence of hand movements as a person works with dough on a smooth, light-colored, marbled countertop. The scene begins with an overhead view of the workspace, where pre-cut dough pieces are scattered, including some arranged in a neat grid and others loosely placed. A wooden rolling pin and a pastry scraper rest nearby, slightly dusted with flour. The camera then transitions to a closer view of the hands, which enter the frame from the top right side. The person uses their left thumb to press a beige dough piece into a green dough segment, combining the two. The right hand closes around the dough, pressing it firmly, while the left hand supports it from below. The person continues to shape the dough, rotating and rolling it to form a smooth, rounded ball. The fingers move efficiently, adjusting the dough as it is gently rolled and pressed to achieve a uniform shape. Shadows from the person’s hands and tools are visible on the countertop, adding depth to the scene. The background showcases the natural veining of the marbled surface, giving the workspace a clean, polished look. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the smooth texture of the dough and the subtle flour dusting on the tools and countertop. The camera remains static, emphasizing the hands and their precise movements throughout the process.

He uses metal tongs to pick up bite-sized snacks from a tray filled with golden, bite-sized snacks and a silver cooking skimmer, placing them into a white paper cup with brown stripes and some writing. The man appears focused and deliberate in his movements, with a soft ambient light illuminating his face. In front of him, another tray holds food in a rich sauce, with two cutlery items visible on the lower side. The scene is set against a backdrop of a red-painted indoor space, filled with various items and papers with writings and drawings stuck on one side of the wall. The camera captures the man in a medium shot at eye level, tilting up to show his concentrated expression as he continues to pack the food. A large poster with a drawing and writing is partially visible on his left. The bright and inviting colors, along with the fast and adept movements of the vendor, create an appetizing and lively culinary experience.

prompt_en: A woman with long straight dark hair, dressed in an all-black outfit including a long black coat, black boots, and a black shoulder bag, walks away from a police station. She is filmed in the center of the scene in a wide shot at eye level. Her hair blows gently, and her expression is serious. She is looking off-screen to the left at the beginning of the video. As she walks, she looks straight ahead toward the right side of the scene. She holds a mobile phone in her right hand and gestures with her left hand. The two people approach the building on either side of the scene. She looks down at the smartphone in her hand and maintains a steady stride, looking at her phone throughout her movement. Her posture remains upright, and she glances upwards and looks around with a look of concern on her face. The two people attempt to go up a stone staircase on either side of the building as a third person exits the building and begins to go down the right-hand side. In the background, a large building with a sign in a foreign language indicating it is a police station is visible. A white police car in front of the building faces the camera. The building has a simple structure, painted burnt-red walls with cream molding, a slanted grey roof that is partially visible, and windows along the facade. Two uniformed police officers are stationed at the entrance, which is elevated, standing on either side of the doorway. On the far right of the scene, next to the building, are trees and shrubbery. The camera's movements are random throughout the video, and the film ends in a medium shot of the woman who looks down off-camera toward the center of the scene, holding the phone in both hands. The setting is an overcast day with soft shadows on the ground.

prompt_en: A young woman sits in a cozy restaurant, engaging with the camera as she enjoys a meal. She is centered in the frame, wearing a vibrant neon pink and black color block windbreaker over an orange shirt, complemented by dangly earrings, a necklace, silver rings, and long, neon pink and yellow nails. Her dark hair cascades over her shoulders, adding to her lively appearance. She is positioned at a booth with a light table and a red cushioned bench, surrounded by various dining items.  The table in front of her holds a white teapot, a small paper tray with red sauce, a round metal steamer filled with dumplings and a white spoon, and a tan plate with black chopsticks. She initially holds a yellow bun in her right hand, taking bites and gesturing with her left hand as she speaks. Her movements are fluid and expressive, with her head occasionally tilting to the side as she takes a bite. The background reveals metallic shelving stocked with plates and paper products, and a transparent panel above the booth reflects the warm, artificial lighting, which casts a yellowish hue across the scene. The overall ambiance is casual and inviting, capturing the essence of a relaxed dining experience.

prompt_en: A wide shot at eye level captures the cozy interior of a room with a rustic charm. The ceiling is adorned with large wooden beams, and the walls are painted a warm beige. The floor is a uniform light brown, complemented by dark brown baseboards. On the left side of the room, a set of dark wooden shelves stands tall, housing an American football ball at its top center. Below the shelves, there are cabinets, and to their right, a granite countertop with a stainless steel sink and undercabinet lighting. Dark wooden cabinets line the wall above the countertop, and a closed wooden door is situated to its right. Pool cues hang neatly on a wall rack nearby.  In front of the shelves, an L-shaped plush gray couch invites relaxation, adorned with colorful cushions in red, yellow, and striped patterns. A square coffee table with a glass top sits in front of the couch, holding a remote control. The scene transitions smoothly as the camera pans right, revealing a separate room with wooden walls and a sliding wooden door that is open. Inside, a pool table made of polished wood is positioned, with balls arranged for play and an overhead light fixture illuminating its surface. Further in, a bathroom with an open door is visible, showcasing a white toilet. The entire setting is bathed in warm, inviting lighting, creating a comfortable and homely atmosphere.

prompt_en: A culinary presentation unfolds on a rectangular plate set against a warm, dark wooden backdrop. The video begins with a high-angle medium shot, showcasing a white plate adorned with a decorative green leaf pattern on the upper right corner. Atop the plate sits a bowl filled with a rich, red-orange sauce, speckled with chilli flakes and small chunks, creating a textured and appetizing appearance. To the left of the bowl, a vibrant garnish of curly green lettuce, cilantro leaves, and two thin orange sticks adds a fresh and colorful touch.  As the camera slowly pans down, revealing more of the plate, a row of five translucent rolls comes into view. These rolls are tightly wrapped in thin rice paper, offering a glimpse of their colorful fillings. The first roll on the left contains elongated white stuffing, while the second roll displays overlapping slices of orange fruit. The third roll reveals green-colored, star-shaped slices arranged in a pattern. The fourth roll showcases pinkish-orange fillings and cilantro leaves, and the fifth roll features light green and orange fillings. The arrangement is symmetrical, and the rolls are positioned in a straight line beneath the sauce bowl, creating a visually appealing and balanced composition.  The lighting is even, highlighting the vibrant colors of the ingredients and casting soft shadows around the objects. The camera maintains a steady medium shot throughout, capturing the entire sequence with a slight pedestal-down motion, emphasizing the freshness and appeal of the dish.

prompt_en: A close-up shot captures a vibrant and appetizing meal served in a white bowl, set against a patterned gray surface. The focal point is the dish, which consists of three distinct components: a bed of chopped leafy greens on the left, a hearty stew in the center, and a scoop of mashed avocado on top. The stew is rich and colorful, containing chunks of orange carrots, green celery, and small, light-colored beans, all melded together in a thick, red-brown sauce. The leafy greens are a mix of darker and lighter hues of green, providing a fresh contrast to the stew. The mashed avocado, bright yellowish-green and creamy, sits atop the stew, adding a smooth texture to the dish. The camera angle is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the textures and colors of the food. The lighting highlights the details, casting subtle shadows on the lower right side of the bowl and reflecting brightly on the top edge. The background remains out of focus, emphasizing the stationary dish and the random camera movements that capture the intricate details of the meal.

prompt_en: A woman is depicted walking along a scenic walkway, her back turned to the camera. She is wearing a black and white mid-thigh checkered dress with sleeveless shoulders and an A-line skirt. Her long, wavy hair cascades down her back as she moves steadily forward. The walkway is adorned with elegant black street lamps and a black metal railing with a dimly lit string of lights hanging above. The railing to the left, black in color, runs parallel to a serene body of turquoise water, casting shadows on the walkway. To her right, a brown railing with vertical balusters and intricate, arched detailing at the top is mounted on a cream-colored, raised platform that contrasts sharply with the railing’s color. As she walks, her shadow becomes visible, moving along the raised platform, adding a dynamic element to the scene and highlighting the bright natural light illuminating the area.  The setting is a vibrant urban environment with stunning modern architectural landmarks placed prominently in the background. Among these, the tallest building dominates the skyline, glistening under the bright midday sun. This skyscraper has a sleek, silver facade with a tapering design reaching high into the clear blue sky. Adjacent buildings are also modern, featuring shiny glass exteriors. The overall atmospheric mood is peaceful yet dynamic, with the juxtaposition of the tranquil water and the lively cityscape. The video maintains a tracking forward motion, depicting the woman moving centrally within the frame, emphasizing the symmetry of the architectural vista ahead captured in a wide shot from an eye-level perspective.

prompt_en: The video showcases a series of chocolate bars arranged on a clean, white surface. The sequence begins with a close-up, high-angle shot that pans right, revealing multiple rows of neatly aligned chocolate bars. The camera starts with a single chocolate bar prominently displayed in the foreground, with its glossy, dark brown surface and uniform square segments clearly visible. As the camera moves, another row of similar bars appears to the right, with one end of each bar extending diagonally across the frame. The background features a blurred second row of chocolate bars, adding depth to the composition.  The camera continues to pan and then zoom in, focusing on the intricate details of the main chocolate bar. The embossed lettering on the top of the bar becomes the central focus, highlighting the artisanal craftsmanship. The lighting is soft and diffused, coming from an overhead source, which enhances the reflective quality of the chocolate's surface. The white background contrasts beautifully with the rich brown tones of the chocolate, emphasizing its smooth and polished texture. The camera movement is deliberate and steady, ensuring that the viewer can appreciate the meticulous design and quality of the chocolate bars.

prompt_en: In a medium shot at eye level, two men are working on a red brick wall. One man, wearing a dark red Under Armour shirt with gray diagonal stripes on the sleeves and a smartwatch on his wrist, holds two metal rods. The other man, with a full beard and slightly receding hairline, stands in the foreground, gripping a yellow and black caulking gun with a white tube labeled with blue and red letters. He pulls the gun away from the wall, revealing a hole where the rod will be inserted. The man in the red shirt then carefully inserts the metal rod into the hole, turning it to ensure it is securely in place. The background features a wooden shelf with a framed photo, a large clear glass jug, and a dark-colored glass bottle. The shelf is set against a gray wall with a white window frame and tan-colored blinds. The room is illuminated by a mix of artificial and natural light.

prompt_en: A heartwarming scene unfolds in a cozy, large beige oval-shaped pet bed with plush tan cloths draped over it, creating a serene and comfortable setting. At the center of this nurturing environment lies an adorable pug, lying down with its body relaxed and front legs stretched out slightly forward. The pug's fur is an apricot fawn texture with light portions and a touch of black extending from its head to its tail, while its ears are entirely black. Its large dark eyes shift slightly, often glancing to its left or downward. Beside the pug, four fluffy ducklings are huddled closely against its left side, their bright yellow feathers contrasting beautifully with the neutral tones of the bed and the dog. The ducklings exhibit gentle motion, occasionally pecking at the pug's fur or nuzzling into its side.  As the video progresses, a bright flash appears, causing the pug to widen its eyes swiftly. Another flash is directed toward the animals, prompting the middle duckling to move to the left. The dog looks a bit toward it, adding a touch of curiosity to the tender moment. The soft, indirect lighting enhances the tranquil atmosphere, highlighting the textures of the pug's fur and the downy fluff of the ducklings. The background showcases a dark wooden floor illuminated by a cool-toned light, with slightly visible sticks. The camera remains steady throughout, capturing the gentle and heartwarming interaction between the pug and the ducklings.

prompt_en: In the video, a man stands in front of multiple containers and platters of food, engaging in a demonstration or presentation. The man has short, black hair and wears a light purple button-down shirt with the top button open and his sleeves rolled up, along with a white over-the-ear microphone on his right ear, as he speaks throughout the video. He looks downward at a white container, placing its transparent top on it, and then wipes his hands with a cloth before removing the top again. He briefly turns his head to look and speak at a piece of black recording equipment coming in from the left before returning his gaze to the container, turning it around. He then hovers his right hand in front of him, taps once on an obscured object with his index finger, and slightly extends his left arm before wiping his finger on the cloth again. The camera remains static in a medium shot at eye level throughout the entire video.  The setting is well-lit, with the light highlighting the man and the food as he stands in front of a black backdrop. To the right is a green background with orange and light olive colorations at the top, featuring a large, white "S" with the word "Healthy" in the same color below it in the middle, though the rest of this background is obscured. Multiple sandwiches and sliced pieces of watermelon and honeydew lie on the surface to the left on white plates. The sandwiches are wrapped in white and red paper, and to their right is a basket with white cloth over it and a plastic container with an orange substance inside it. The piece of recording equipment is visible from the beginning but is pulled back away from the frame toward the end of the video.

prompt_en: Two vloggers are having a lively conversation as they stroll through an outdoor market area. A dynamic low-angle medium shot captures their interaction, with the camera following their movements closely, creating a sense of motion and engagement. The angle showcases a quarter profile of both individuals, emphasizing their expressions and gestures.  The man, wearing a vibrant green hoodie and a crossbody bag with a gray strap, has short black hair and a thin tattoo behind his right ear. He looks forward, occasionally glancing downward, and then back up, his smile reflecting his enthusiasm. The woman beside him, with long straight black hair, holds a paper coffee cup in her right hand. She is dressed in a white top with a tan vest adorned with sherpa accents, complemented by a matching crossbody bag. Her arm gestures emphatically as she speaks, her smile warm and engaging.  The setting is a bustling outdoor market with a distinctly East Asian architectural style, characterized by dark wooden structures and traditional lanterns hanging overhead. The sun is bright, casting clear shadows beneath the awnings and the people, with a few scattered clouds adding depth to the vivid blue sky. Blurred figures of other shoppers can be seen in the background, contributing to the lively atmosphere.

prompt_en: In a well-lit veterinary clinic, a woman in a light blue T-shirt with two white buttons on her left shoulder is examining a black and white Border Collie. The dog, with its dark brown and white fur, stands calmly between the woman and a man wearing a light pink T-shirt and a gray backward-facing baseball cap. The woman, with her light brown hair tied back, holds a stethoscope and gently places it on the dog's chest. The man, with short brown hair peeking out from under his cap, has his arms wrapped around the dog, providing support. The dog's mouth is initially open, revealing its tongue and teeth, but it soon turns its face towards the woman, causing her to smile widely. The man's lips are initially closed and tight, but he then begins to smile mildly. The woman continues to examine the dog, moving the stethoscope along its body. The dog turns its face towards the camera, and the woman removes the stethoscope. The background features white walls and two large computer screens displaying medical data, adding to the clinical setting. The scene captures a moment of interaction and care between the veterinarian and the pet owner.

prompt_en: A man with a stubbled beard and short hair, dressed in a dark sportcoat, shirt, and pants, walks and talks in a luxurious, opulent interior. The environment exudes elegance with a color palette of white, gold, and black, illuminated by a warm blend of artificial and natural lighting from the windows and the ceiling, respectively. White, long pillars extend from the floor up to the high ceilings, with intricately molded, grandly indented tops that curve down to meet each pillar. A staircase with black railing mesh spirals up, adorned with thinly rectangular window panels. Dark and glossy countertops flank both sides; the left countertop features a silvery, metallic faucet indicative of a kitchen area, while the right countertop holds chairs and a fancy decoration centerpiece depicting small, white figures with golden hair, enhancing the grandeur.  The man, wearing a gray wristwatch on his left hand, approaches the camera while speaking and gesturing animatedly. The camera begins with a medium shot, then pushes out and arcs to the left, orbiting around the man to reveal more of the vast, spacious interior. The brick-patterned ceiling above is lined with white lighting, and the cupboards to the right feature curved indentations on their paneling. As the camera continues to arc, it captures the circular table with chairs and windows that hint at green trees just outside. The sequence ends with the man coming to a stop at the circular table, still engaged in conversation.

prompt_en: A young woman with long, straight red-brown hair is seen in a softly lit, warmly ambient setting. Her hair elegantly drapes over her left shoulder, the ends slightly curled, while her dark eyes engage the camera. She wears a boat neck shirt with a solid black upper section that transitions to a red below her mid-chest, with red trim accentuating the design. A delicate necklace rests around her neck, adding to her appearance. Her posture is relaxed, with her arms extended downward and coming close together. Throughout the sequence, she maintains a soft smile, her lips curved. She begins by opening her eyes and gazing directly at the camera, before blinking and shifting her gaze to the right. After a moment, she looks back to the camera, briefly lowering her eyes, then tilting her head to the left as she gazes up again. Finally, she places her right hand near her lips, her fingers curled with her index finger lightly touching her mouth while maintaining a steady, focused look at the camera. The setting has a warm, dimly lit ambiance, with a brick wall faintly visible to the left and a transparent panel on her right gently catching the light. Behind her, a blurry wall and slightly colorful panels are faintly visible. The lighting casts a golden glow over her skin and hair, highlighting her natural beauty. The video is captured in a medium shot at eye level, the camera initially static, then panning to the right, before adopting random movements.

prompt_en: A man in a dark-colored suit, white shirt, black socks, and black shoes hangs precariously from the side of an aircraft during takeoff. The camera tracks his motion, capturing a wide shot from a high angle, filming a side view of him on the soaring aircraft and the blurred motion of the runway below. He grips onto a series of large circular holes on the side of a gray-colored plane, with some holes open and others closed. Two black ropes extend from the top of the side door to behind him, and another rope reaches from the left, connecting to an open hole. The man's feet are initially on the wing, but as the plane ascends, they slide off, and he struggles to maintain his grip. His face shows strain, with furrowed brows and an open mouth revealing his teeth due to the strong wind forces. His jacket billows in the wind as he attempts to adjust his footing by lifting his right leg once and his left leg twice. He eventually loses his foothold, and his legs and feet hang down as he clings to the side of the plane. The background shifts slightly, revealing patches of green grass beside the tarmac on the right. The scene takes place outdoors during the daytime in natural lighting, softly highlighting the man and surroundings.

prompt_en: A man is engaged in climbing up a rocky path, wearing a blue helmet with a camera attached to it. He is on an ascent, gripping a rock with his right hand for support as he climbs past it. The camera captures a wide shot from an eye-level perspective, showcasing the surrounding landscape. He wears a vibrant orange t-shirt and carries a large, yellow backpack with green straps strapped securely over his shoulders and chest. Glancing into the camera on his left, he speaks while the camera shifts to a low angle. He then turns his gaze upward before turning back to the camera, smiling and highlighting the scenic backdrop. With his right index finger, he gestures toward the mountain before facing the camera again, his smile reflecting his enthusiasm. The lighting is vibrant, showcasing the sunlit peaks and casting shadows across the stony terrain. The scene unfolds against a stunning backdrop of a rugged, rocky mountain range, with a streak of snow nestled between the jagged peaks, coming into view toward the end of the video. The mountain landscape is characterized by sheer cliffs, jagged rocks, and a clear blue sky speckled with a few fluffy clouds. The camera movement is tracking the man, capturing various angles of his journey.

prompt_en: In this medium shot captured at a slightly low angle, the camera gently shakes with random slight tremors, creating a dynamic and immersive feel. The central figure is a man in a dark green and black tracksuit, standing confidently with short hair, a beard, and a mustache. He holds a microphone in his right hand, engaging in conversation with two women on either side of him. To his left, a woman is being interviewed; she wears a black puffy jacket over a light pink sports jersey, with her hair neatly combed back and tied in a ponytail that drapes over her left shoulder. A beige paper bag hangs from her right wrist. On his right stands another woman, dressed in a black jacket over a gray hoodie with a red logo, her hair styled in corn rows at the front and an afro puff on the back of her head.   The man looks to his right at the woman talking, while the woman on the right runs her left palm over the back of her head. He then pulls the microphone closer to himself and speaks, causing the woman on the right to quickly bend forward, smiling, before straightening up and crossing her arms, looking to her left. The man continues to hold the microphone towards the other woman, and the camera pans slightly left to focus on her. She turns her head to her left, and the man speaks again. She takes a quick look over her left shoulder.  The background reveals a bustling urban setting. To the left, a large set of stairs is crowded with people, while the escalators next to them are not functioning. The middle of the frame showcases a gray sky peeking through the upper left corner. On the right side, columns and the bottom corner of an electronic screen are visible. The scene is bathed in the soft, diffused light of an overcast day, adding a natural and candid quality to the moment.

prompt_en: A thrilling outdoor adventure unfolds as a motorcyclist navigates a narrow, rugged mountain trail. The rider, clad in a vivid yellow-green and black jacket, expertly maneuvers along a precarious dirt road that hugs the jagged mountain's edge. Positioned at a moderate distance behind another motorcyclist in dark clothing, the rider skillfully handles the powerful motorcycle, which kicks up dust as it speeds along the path. The scene is framed by a sheer rock wall on the left and a breathtaking, expansive drop on the right. Shadows play across the trail, reflecting the rugged terrain, and the camera follows closely behind the motorcyclist, capturing the dynamic movement and the stunning scenery. As the rider passes by the tallest section of the rock wall, the route opens up into an expansive view of rolling mountains and valleys under a clear blue sky. The sunlight illuminates the scene, casting dark shadows on the rock wall and the trail, while the background reveals a dark vehicle and faint outlines of other people, adding depth to the adventurous journey.

prompt_en: A serene beach scene captures an artist meticulously crafting a highly detailed sand sculpture of a large face on a breezy day. The artist, a man in a light blue shirt and dark pants, kneels beside the sculpture, carefully smoothing and shaping the sand to create the neck. He occasionally glances up to look at the camera before returning his focus to the work. The sand sculpture rises majestically from the beach surface, showcasing the artist’s impressive skill in sand art. To the artist's right, two individuals in blue outfits sit, with a cluster of tall, colorful toys and other miscellaneous items between them. In the background, a bustling yet tranquil beach scene unfolds with numerous beachgoers wandering or relaxing on the sand, some sitting in colorful chairs and others lining up on the shore. The sky is overcast, and the ocean waves softly crash onto the beach. The lighting is natural, with brown tones dominating the shot due to the lack of strong sunlight. The camera pushes in on the artwork, offering a detailed perspective that allows viewers to appreciate its intricate details while observing the lively beach setting.

prompt_en: A woman is singing passionately on stage, holding a black cordless microphone in her right hand. She stands confidently on a geometric-patterned rug with shades of brown and beige, wearing an elegant off-shoulder, beige-colored dress adorned with soft ruffles and paired with flat, gold shoes featuring vertical stripes. Her brown hair is slightly curled at the bottom, adding to her graceful appearance. Initially, she sings with her eyes closed, making open hand gestures with her left hand before lowering it naturally. The camera begins with a wide shot from a high angle, pushing in to capture her at a medium shot as she opens her eyes and gazes to the right of the frame. The camera then slightly tilts up and pushes her in again, maintaining a medium shot.  In the background, a man with short black hair, dressed entirely in black, plays a keyboard with his head lowered, standing on a black-and-white striped mat. To his left, a black couch is positioned against a wall, with a picture display of pink flowers in a pink and grey frame. On the right side of the frame, a black object lies on the floor near a light stand, and a display of a tree with pink leaves subtly moves in the background. The scene is dimly lit, with artificial lighting from a lamp in the background casting a warm glow, though it does not fully illuminate the entire setting.

prompt_en: In a modern, well-lit kitchen with sleek white cabinetry and reflective surfaces, two women are engaged in a lively conversation. The woman on the right, sporting short blond hair and a shiny silver jacket, gestures animatedly with her left arm extended toward the camera, her expression lively and enthusiastic. Meanwhile, the woman on the left, with long straight dark hair and patterned clothing in shades of purple and orange, turns to her left, covering her mouth with her hands as if reacting to something amusing. As the conversation progresses, the woman in purple shifts her gaze to the right, lowering her arms, while the woman in silver continues to talk, her left arm gradually dropping. The woman with long hair then touches her hair with her right arm before turning to her right, placing her left arm on the counter. She picks up a spatula and begins stirring a dish in a pan on the stove, her movements fluid and energetic. The woman in purple raises her left arm and brings it down, continuing to talk, while the woman in silver maintains her focus on the spatula, her laughter adding to the dynamic interaction. The camera captures their lively exchange from a medium shot, maintaining an eye-level angle throughout, highlighting the warmth and brightness of the kitchen setting.

prompt_en: A top-down point-of-view shot captures a pair of hands holding a gold Samsung smartphone horizontally. The hands, with neatly trimmed short fingernails, rest on a textured dark wood surface. The smartphone screen displays a stock market graph with green and red bars, accompanied by numerical data at the top and right side. The top left corner features an unclear logo and name, while the bottom shows indistinct numbers. An indiscernible green, red, yellow, and white object is visible in the top left corner. The video is shot in a well-lit area, with artificial light casting shadows of the hands and phone on the gray textured wooden surface. Initially, the left hand holds the phone steady, revealing a silver watch on the wrist. The right hand enters the frame from the bottom left, performing a pinch-out gesture on the screen, causing it to zoom in. The hand then pinches the screen twice, resulting in a further zoom-out. After removing the hand, the person waves before swiping the screen to the left. The hand hovers in the air, making additional hand gestures, and the video concludes. The setting is well-lit, casting distinct shadows on the surface below.

prompt_en: A medium shot of a person slicing cooked meat outdoors, captured from a slightly high angle with the camera gradually zooming out. The person's hands, clad in blue sleeves rolled up, are positioned in the left foreground as they skillfully slice the food pieces on a rustic wooden cutting board. The meat has a golden-brown charred exterior, with each precise slice revealing a juicy light interior. The person uses a large, sharp kitchen knife with a black handle and an engraved silver blade with a circle design in the corner. They hold the knife in their right hand while stabilizing the meat with their left. The first chunk of meat is cut into six nearly even slices and shifted slightly with the knife to the right side of the cutting board to make room for the second chunk as they pull it to the center with the left fingers and place the knife over it. Another piece of an irregular-shaped chunk of meat remains on the left side of the board. The background showcases lush pale green vegetation and a thick layer of moss covering the ground, with natural lighting brightly illuminating the scene. Tall trees with branches bearing leaves are visible at the top of the frame. In the top left corner, an open campfire surrounded by dark, irregular rocks and gray ashes emits bright orange flames. Heaped structures covered in pale green moss are visible close to the fireplace.

prompt_en: A scenic clip captures a man riding his bike along a two-way cycling path in a picturesque mountainous landscape. The camera follows him from behind, moving randomly as he pedals along the path, which runs parallel to a two-way highway on its right. In this eye-level wide shot, the man is wearing a dark t-shirt, shorts, sneakers, and a head covering, with a small, dark-colored backpack slung over his shoulders. Two cyclists pass by from the opposite direction on the same path; the first is wearing a black short-sleeve shirt and shorts, while the second is in a white and blue cycling shirt with black shorts, both on bright orange bikes with thin, dark wheels. On the left side of the frame, a wire fence separates the cycling track from a forest filled with tall pine trees. Between the fence and the path is a short line of rocks piled on one another with green vegetation sticking out toward the trail. On the right side of the paved biking trail, a concrete barrier divides the path from the highway, where cars frequently pass in both directions. Between the barrier and the trail is a darker patch of land with green vegetation lining the path. A long green median runs along the center of the highway, separating the two directions of traffic. To the right of the far lane, there are two rows of tall pine trees separated by a tan formation where the second row of pines can be seen in the distance. The scene is enveloped by a breathtaking natural landscape and a majestic mountain range on the left that forms a striking background under a blue sky dotted with fluffy clouds. The whole scene is bathed in bright daylight, enhancing the clarity of the foreground and the depth of the background. The ambiance suggests a tranquil yet invigorating activity amidst stunning natural beauty, embodying the essence of outdoor exploration.

prompt_en: A medium shot of a commercial dough preparation process in a professional kitchen. A person wearing a plaid gray apron and white gloves is partially visible from the waist down on the left, operating a dough-rolling machine with an orange safety guard. The machine, wide and flat, sits prominently in the foreground. The individual uses their left hand to hold the gray crank handle on the side of the machine, while their right hand adjusts the dough. The dough, an elongated oval, slides out from the machine onto the flat white surface below the orange guard. The person then lifts the dough, gaining momentum with a swooping tilt to the right, and rotates it 90 degrees clockwise so that the wide edge faces the camera. They sprinkle a white powder on the dough with their right hand, which returns to the frame, while their left hand remains on the crank. In the background, an industrial green mixer rotates around a large silver bowl, and a black-framed window with bright light pouring in is visible in the upper right corner. A metal box with a red switch labeled "ON" and "OFF" is situated next to the crank. The setting is brightly lit with a mix of natural and artificial light, reflecting off the top of the machine.

prompt_en: The video captures a serene outdoor scene with a vibrant flower field and a majestic mountain view. A dense carpet of violet-pink flowers stretches across the foreground, creating a stunning visual display. A paved pathway curves around the flowers in a counterclockwise direction, with a fork leading to the right. People stroll and stand along the path, dressed in long-sleeved shirts and pants. A woman wearing a broad-brimmed beige sunhat and a long white tunic walks away from the camera, her hat and tunic swaying gently in the breeze. Another woman in a black-and-white checkered dress, black leggings, and a tote bag pauses to take a photograph of the flowers. Three individuals facing the camera and walking toward the right carry umbrellas for shade.  To the right of the path, a field of pale green grass with light sand-colored soil stretches out, bordered by knee-high landscape fences of wooden posts and white cords. The camera begins with a tilt-up, revealing a clear and sunny day with bright natural light. Further afield, people stroll along distant paths, adding life to the tranquil setting. A band of trees in varying shades of olive green spans the frame, with a cluster of tall dark evergreens in the middle. The most prominent peak in the backdrop is a snow-capped mountain, dominating the horizon. Fluffy white clouds hover at the peak of the snow-capped mountain and at the tops of the lower mountains. The sky is a clear, light steel blue, occupying the top half of the frame. The overall scene is peaceful and picturesque, capturing the beauty of nature and human activity harmoniously.

prompt_en: A man is tending to a small fire in a woodland setting, captured in a medium shot at an eye-level angle. He is kneeling on the forest floor, which is covered with dirt, twigs, and leaves. The man, with a full beard and wearing a brown jacket layered over a hoodie, olive-green pants, and a knit hat, is focused on the fire in front of him. His posture is slightly hunched as he carefully picks up small wooden splinters with his right hand, placing them near the fire. The fire, surrounded by kindling, produces thick white smoke that drifts upwards, partially obscuring the view in the lower right corner of the frame. The camera pans slightly to the right, bringing the man into the center of the frame. Afterward, he leans back slightly, adjusts his posture, and picks up a pair of gloves with both hands. He shakes the gloves gently before pressing them together with his hands. The background showcases a dense woodland area with tall trees, and a faint sky peaking through the sparse treetops with some warm yellowish light filtering through. A backpack is visible behind him, resting against a wooden structure, with additional gear and supplies nearby. The color palette of the scene is dominated by earthy tones of greens, browns, and gray, with soft natural lighting.

prompt_en: In a medium, eye-level shot, two women are depicted in a moment of shared sorrow. On the right, a young woman with long, straight black hair and a moss-green garment with a subtle black animal print stands beside an older woman. The young woman's head is slightly tilted towards the older woman, who has a round face, a double chin, and a small mole on her right cheek. Her black hair is neatly groomed and mostly covered by a maroon scarf. The young woman holds her right hand over the right side of her mouth, fingertips pressing her nose, with a distressed expression and downward-turning mouth. Her gaze is directed downwards, and her bottom lip quivers. The older woman, with a melancholic expression, looks in the same direction before briefly lifting her gaze to meet the younger woman's eyes. The younger woman then tucks her fingers under her nose, her head lifting slightly as she stares to the left. Shadows under her green-toned eyes hint at the emotional weight, and a tear rolls down her left cheek. The camera subtly zooms in, capturing the nuanced expressions and the warm, diffused lighting. In the blurred background, a window with a teal-colored frame covered with black bars is set in a tan-colored wall.

prompt_en: A serene, modern indoor scene unfolds in a minimalist bedroom, focusing on a sleek white bunk bed as the centerpiece. The video begins with a low-angle, wide shot that captures the entire bunk bed, emphasizing its clean lines and simple design. The lower bunk features a white mattress adorned with a patterned pillow, while the top bunk casts a shadow on the adjacent wall. A curved black ladder leads to the upper bunk, which is partially visible due to the angle. The underside of the top bunk is finished with a warm brown tone.  In the foreground, a dark green-and-white geometric bedside rug lies on a light brown floor, adding a touch of pattern to the otherwise monochromatic space. To the left, a sleek black-framed glass door opens to a porch or balcony, where trees, lawns, and an outdoor wooden table set are visible, allowing natural light to stream in. A portion of a chair can be seen in the bottom left corner, while a gray pot holding a potted plant with dark green stems and lemon-green leaves stands to the far right.  As the camera slowly pedestals upward, the shot transitions to a high-angle view, revealing more of the top bunk and the white ceiling with two round recessed lights. The soft, neutral white glow from these lights complements the natural light coming through the glass door. The video maintains a calm and inviting atmosphere, with the bunk bed serving as the focal point amidst the minimalist decor and natural elements.
