prompt_en: The video opens with a wide shot of an indoor volleyball court within a large stadium, featuring tiered seating filled with spectators. The court is marked with standard volleyball lines and covered with a green and pink playing surface. Two teams are positioned on opposite sides of the net: one in black uniforms and the other in blue. The team in black appears ready to serve, while the team in blue is positioned to receive the ball. A referee in a purple shirt stands near the net, observing the play. The background displays various advertisements, including prominent ones for "TOYOTA," "R-1," and "Mikasa." The scoreboard at the top left corner shows the score as "ITA 2 - 8" and "THA 1 - 7," indicating that Italy is leading Thailand in this match.  As the serve is executed by the team in black, the ball is hit over the net towards the team in blue. The players in blue react swiftly; one player in blue jumps high, making contact with the ball mid-air, sending it back across the net. The camera follows the ball's trajectory, capturing the players' movements and reactions as they prepare for the next play. The sequence highlights the athleticism and coordination required in volleyball, with players moving quickly and strategically to maintain possession of the ball. The final frame captures the ball in mid-air after being hit by the player in blue, with players from both teams positioned to react, emphasizing the fast-paced nature of the game.

prompt_en: The video opens in a gymnasium where two individuals are practicing judo. The setting features a wooden floor mat, characteristic of a judo training area, and walls adorned with various notices and children's artwork pinned to boards. The person in the white judo gi, wearing a black belt, is positioned over the individual in the blue gi, who is bent forward on the mat. The person in white leans forward, preparing to execute a judo throw. As the sequence progresses, the individual in white lifts their legs into the air, transitioning from a bent position to an upright stance, indicating the start of a judo throw. The person in blue remains stationary, supporting the weight of the individual in white as they lift off the ground. By the final frame, the person in white is fully elevated, demonstrating the completion of the throw, while the person in blue maintains their supportive position on the mat. The camera captures this dynamic moment from a low angle, emphasizing the fluidity and precision of the judo technique.

The man remains stationary, focused on receiving the punches. The scene maintains a consistent setting, with the background remaining unchanged. prompt_en: The video opens with a scene set outdoors under a clear blue sky, likely at an archery range. Three men and one woman stand on a gravel surface near a covered structure, possibly a shooting range shelter. The man on the left, wearing a white t-shirt, black pants, and a backward baseball cap, holds a bow. The central figure, dressed in a brown shirt and jeans, gestures animatedly while speaking, and the man on the right, wearing a dark t-shirt, beige cargo shorts, and a black cap, also holds a bow. The woman is partially visible in white shorts, flannel top, and reflective glasses. Directly behind the man in the white tee, a small utility vehicle is parked, and the background features trees and hills, suggesting a rural setting. As the video progresses, they engage in a lively discussion. The central figure continues to gesture expressively. The man on the right of the central figure listens attentively, occasionally nodding and responding, while the man on the left of the frame adjusts his stance, appearing to listen intently. The woman can be seen in between the two men on the right of the frame, laughing. The interaction suggests a collaborative or instructional moment, possibly related to archery techniques or equipment. By the final frame, the men continue their discussion, maintaining their positions near the covered structure. The man on the left, still holding his bow, listens closely, while the central figure continues to gesture, and the man on the right, remains attentive. The overall scene remains consistent, with the men engaged in conversation amidst the rural backdrop.  A medium shot captures the group from a slightly elevated perspective, emphasizing their dynamic interaction and the surrounding environment. The gravel ground and the covered structure add depth to the scene, while the utility vehicle and the natural backdrop enhance the rural setting. The video maintains a casual yet focused atmosphere, highlighting the camaraderie and shared interest among the participants.

prompt_en: A dynamic padel match unfolds on a vibrant green artificial turf court, enclosed by a tall black metal fence and marked by vivid blue walls. The scene is set against an overcast sky, with lush greenery visible beyond the fence, suggesting a secluded outdoor location. A young man, dressed in a black short-sleeved shirt, black shorts with white stripes, and black athletic shoes, stands near the center of the court, holding a red padel racket in his right hand. He faces the blue wall, preparing to receive an incoming yellow padel ball. As the ball approaches, he swings his racket with precision, hitting it back towards the wall. His movements are fluid and controlled, demonstrating his focus and skill. The final frame captures the man mid-swing, having just made contact with the ball, which is now in motion, heading back towards the opposite side of the court.

prompt_en: A dynamic video sequence captures a man running energetically across a well-maintained soccer field under a clear blue sky. Dressed in a red long-sleeve shirt and patterned shorts featuring red, white, and blue stripes, complemented by black athletic shoes, the man showcases his athletic form as he moves swiftly across the field. The field is marked with white boundary lines, and in the background, a chain-link fence encloses the area, beyond which stand tall trees, driving cars, and a few residential houses. The man's run is focused and determined, transitioning into a more dynamic movement as he bends his knees and shifts his weight forward before changing direction. The camera captures these movements smoothly, emphasizing his fluid motion and the vibrant green of the field. The final frame shows the man mid-stride, his body leaning forward in anticipation, with the field and distant scenery still visible behind him.

They hold a tablet in their left hand and gesture with their right hand towards the ceiling, seemingly discussing or pointing out features of the space. The room is minimally furnished, with a window covered by plastic sheeting to protect it from dust and debris, a partially visible saw stand frame on the left, and a ladder on the right, indicating ongoing work at a higher elevation. The walls are bare and unfinished, with some areas showing signs of plaster or drywall. The person appears engaged in a discussion, moving their right hand slightly while maintaining their grip on the tablet. The setting suggests a professional or collaborative environment, with the individual actively involved in planning or assessing the renovation project.

prompt_en: The video opens with a tennis player standing on a clay court under a clear blue sky. The player, dressed in a light-colored, patterned shirt, gray shorts, white socks, and yellow tennis shoes, holds a tennis racket in his right hand and a ball in his left. He appears to be preparing for a serve. Behind him, a chain-link fence separates the court from a row of empty bleachers with orange and white seats. Tall floodlights stand prominently in the background, suggesting the setting is an outdoor tennis facility. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting sharp shadows on the court. The player begins by holding the ball in his left hand and the racket in his right. He then tosses the ball into the air with his left hand while simultaneously bringing the racket back, preparing for a serve. As he serves, the ball is seen flying through the air towards the opposite side of the court. After the serve, the player stands upright, holding the racket in his right hand, and looks in the direction where the ball was hit. In the final frame, the player is standing upright on the clay court, holding the racket in his right hand and looking off to the side, presumably following the trajectory of the served ball. The scene remains consistent with the initial setup, with the clear blue sky, chain-link fence, empty bleachers, and tall floodlights still visible in the background.

Players in yellow jerseys (Lakers) and purple jerseys (Pelicans) are actively engaged in play. A Lakers player in a yellow jersey dribbles the ball while being closely guarded by a Pelican in a purple jersey. The player in yellow passes the ball to a teammate, who then attempts to drive towards the basket but faces defensive pressure from multiple Pelicans. The ball is quickly passed around the perimeter as the Lakers try to find an opening for a shot. The sequence captures the dynamic movement and strategic passing typical of a basketball game, with the focus shifting between offensive and defensive maneuvers. By the final frame, the Lakers player continues to dribble the ball, preparing for another pass or shot attempt, while the Pelicans remain in defensive stance.

prompt_en: The video opens in an indoor gymnastics facility, showcasing various gymnastic equipment such as uneven bars and a pommel horse in the background. The floor is covered with colorful mats in blue, red, and yellow, arranged for different exercises. A woman dressed in black athletic wear is seen jumping on a trampoline. She begins by jumping with her arms raised above her head and her legs straight, then leaps into the air, executing a front flip and landing back on her feet. After completing the flip, she brings her knees up to her chest and her hands to her knees. She then straightens out again, landing her feet on the trampoline once more. The final frame captures her standing upright on the trampoline with her arms to her sides. The setting is well-lit, with a clean and professional atmosphere, emphasizing the dynamic and energetic movements of the gymnast.

prompt_en: A wide shot captures a lively skate park on a sunny day, with a large concrete bowl at its center and another adjacent bowl. The park is enclosed by a chain-link fence, beyond which palm trees and distant urban buildings suggest a coastal cityscape. Several people are scattered around, some seated on benches, others standing or walking, all enjoying the day. In the foreground, a skilled scooter rider, dressed in a dark jacket over a blue shirt, light-colored pants, and a cap, approaches the edge of the bowl. They rotate the scooter to change direction, gaining speed, and begin to navigate the curved surface, leaning into the turns with precision. The rider's movements are fluid and controlled, showcasing their expertise. As the video progresses, the rider continues to ride along the bowl's edge, maintaining balance and momentum. By the final frame, the rider continues the same action in a different direction, still within the bowl, with the park's lively atmosphere continuing in the background.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide shot of a bustling urban plaza, likely in Chicago, centered around the iconic Cloud Gate sculpture, also known as "The Bean." The reflective surface of the sculpture gleams under an overcast sky, mirroring the surrounding buildings and the people around it. The plaza is paved with large, light-colored tiles, and numerous individuals are scattered across the area, some walking towards the sculpture while others are further away, exploring the space. In the background, a mix of modern high-rise buildings rises above the plaza, their windows reflecting the muted light of the day. The overall atmosphere suggests a cool, possibly winter day, as many people are dressed in jackets and hats.  As the video progresses, a person wearing a gray jacket and carrying a black backpack walks from right to left across the frame, passing by the Cloud Gate sculpture. This individual appears to be casually strolling, occasionally adjusting their backpack and looking around. Another person, dressed in a beige coat and white hat, enters the frame from the right side, walking towards the sculpture while holding a phone in one hand. This second individual seems to be focused on their device, perhaps checking directions or taking a photo. The background remains consistent, with other pedestrians moving about the plaza, contributing to the lively yet relaxed ambiance of the scene.  The camera then shifts to a closer view, capturing the reflective surface of the Cloud Gate sculpture in greater detail. The sculpture's polished surface captures the surrounding buildings and the overcast sky, creating a mesmerizing mirror effect. The plaza is now seen from a lower angle, emphasizing the height of the sculpture and the scale of the urban environment. The people in the plaza appear smaller in this perspective, adding a sense of grandeur to the scene.  By the end of the video, the scene continues to depict the same bustling urban plaza with the Cloud Gate sculpture at its center. The reflective surface of the sculpture still gleams under the overcast sky, and the plaza remains populated with people walking and exploring the area. The modern high-rise buildings in the background continue to reflect the muted light, maintaining the cool, possibly winter atmosphere. The overall scene remains lively and dynamic, capturing the essence of a busy city square on a cloudy day.

The court is surrounded by lush greenery, including palm trees and other leafy plants, creating a vibrant backdrop. A light teal building with circular windows stands prominently in the background, alongside a taller structure that hints at a larger complex nearby. The court is marked with white boundary lines, and a basketball hoop is positioned in the upper left corner.  In the foreground, two individuals are engaged in a lively game. One player, wearing a gray sleeveless shirt, blue shorts, white socks, and black sneakers, and glasses, is positioned slightly behind the other. The second player, dressed in a red sleeveless top, black shorts with red and white stripes, and black sneakers, is actively dribbling a brown basketball. The player in red moves slightly to the side while maintaining control of the ball, which bounces on the court surface. The player in gray leans forward with hands outstretched, attempting to block the movements of the individual in red. The scene captures the intensity and focus of the game, with both players fully immersed in the action. The final frame shows the same dynamic, with the player in red continuing to dribble the ball and the player in gray maintaining their defensive stance.

prompt_en: The video opens with a figure skater dressed in a sleek black outfit, gracefully gliding across the ice in an indoor rink. The rink is surrounded by a low white wall topped with a railing, and behind it, large, muted-gray, industrial-style walls with evenly spaced rectangular blocks are visible. Fluorescent lights attached to evenly spaced cylindrical rods suspended from the ceiling cast a bright, even glow over the scene. prompt_en: The video opens with a scene set in an urban parking area, where a row of bicycles is secured to a metal rack. The bicycles vary in design, with some equipped with child seats and panniers, indicating their use for family or commuting purposes. Parked cars line the background, including a blue sedan and a red car, while a wall covered in vibrant graffiti adds a lively, artistic backdrop to the setting. A man, dressed in a gray jacket and carrying a white and red bag slung over his shoulder, walks into the frame from the left side. He approaches the bike rack, reaches out, and begins to climb onto one of the bicycles. After securing himself, he starts pedaling away, moving smoothly down the street. By the final frame, the man has ridden past the camera, leaving the initial urban scene behind.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures two individuals joyfully jumping in a vast, flat snowy landscape. The setting is a serene, expansive field blanketed in snow, with a distant horizon barely visible under a cloudy sky. The person on the left is dressed in a long gray coat, brown pants, a patterned scarf, and a cap, while the individual on the right sports a pink puffer jacket, blue jeans, a light-colored scarf, and their hair tied back. Both are actively engaged, their movements indicating playful energy despite the cold. As the video progresses, they jump repeatedly, moving to their right in a playful dance, their arms outstretched and hands interlocked. The camera follows their dynamic movements, capturing the lively interaction against the tranquil backdrop of the snowy field and overcast sky.

prompt_en: A dynamic indoor soccer training facility with a large, white, dome-shaped ceiling and green turf serves as the backdrop for an agility drill. Yellow cones are arranged in a pattern across the field, creating a path for players to navigate. Two players, both wearing white jerseys with red and blue accents and blue shorts, are engaged in the drill. One player, positioned in the foreground, is actively moving around the cones, showcasing swift and precise footwork. His movements are fluid and controlled, highlighting his agility and skill. The second player, located further back on the left side of the frame, appears to be recovering from a maneuver, adding a sense of realism to the training session. The background includes blue benches and two doors, contributing to the structured environment. As the video progresses, the player in the foreground continues to demonstrate quick reflexes and precision, while the player in the dark uniform remains focused and engaged in the drill. The scene captures the intensity and dedication of the training session, emphasizing the players' commitment to improving their skills.

prompt_en: A close-up view captures a person's hands engaged in a culinary task at a wooden countertop. Dressed in a white shirt, the individual is seen squeezing a white cloth over a small white bowl positioned centrally in the frame. The background reveals a stovetop with a frying pan containing cooked corn kernels, and a wooden spoon rests on the stovetop, indicating prior cooking activity. The person's hands work methodically, applying pressure to the cloth to extract a thin, viscous liquid that drips into the bowl below. The liquid appears to be a clear or light-colored substance, possibly oil or broth. The scene progresses smoothly, focusing on the meticulous process of extracting the liquid, with the bowl gradually filling up. By the final frame, the bowl contains a noticeable amount of the extracted liquid, while the person continues to squeeze the cloth, ensuring no residue is left behind. The overall environment suggests a home kitchen setting, emphasizing the hands-on nature of the cooking process.

prompt_en: A close-up of a man outdoors, savoring a piece of food. He has short gray hair and a neatly trimmed beard, dressed in a gray t-shirt. The man holds a small, triangular slice of food topped with diced tomatoes and possibly other garnishes. His eyes are closed, and his mouth is slightly open as he brings the food closer to his mouth, indicating he is deeply enjoying the taste. The background is softly blurred, showing greenery and a hint of water, suggesting a peaceful lakeside or riverside setting. As the sequence progresses, the man continues to take bites from the food, his eyes remaining closed and his expression conveying deep enjoyment. The background remains consistent throughout, maintaining the serene outdoor environment. By the final frame, the man is still engaged in eating, his focus entirely on the food, with no new objects appearing, and the scene continues to depict the tranquil outdoor setting.

The volleyball is airborne, heading towards the team alongside the net. A player in black is seen mid-jump, preparing to spike the ball. As the sequence progresses, the player in black successfully executes the spike, sending the ball over the net. The opposing team remains alert, anticipating the next move. The final frame captures the aftermath of the spike, with the ball descending towards the team across the net, who are now in position to receive it. prompt_en: A man performs pull-ups on a green horizontal bar set against a backdrop of tall residential buildings under a clear blue sky. The sun is positioned directly behind him, creating a bright lens flare that bathes the scene in a warm glow. The man, shirtless and wearing dark shorts, grips the bar firmly with both hands, lifting his body upwards and then lowering himself back down in a controlled manner. His movements are fluid and deliberate, showcasing his strength and endurance. The background remains static, with the buildings and sky providing a constant, urban setting. The camera angle shifts slightly throughout the sequence, capturing the man from various perspectives as he continues his pull-ups, the sun still shining brightly, and the overall scene retains its serene yet dynamic atmosphere.

The area is bordered by power lines stretching across the sky, and additional trees and benches are visible, enhancing the tranquil suburban atmosphere. As the sequence progresses, the individual approaches the table, bends forward, and leaps onto the ping pong table. The final frame captures the individual mid motion, balancing dynamically atop the table, with the background slightly blurred to emphasize the action.

prompt_en: A documentary-style video captures a group of five individuals jogging along a concrete barrier adjacent to a body of water, likely a river or sea, under an overcast sky. The concrete barrier is marked with some graffiti on its left side, and a metal railing runs along its edge, separating it from the water. The group consists of four men and one woman, all dressed in casual athletic attire suitable for running. The man on the far left wears a black hoodie and black pants, while the second man from the left sports a white hoodie and black pants. The third individual, also male, is clad in a beige jacket and black shorts. The fourth person, another man, is dressed in a similar light gray hoodie paired with black shorts. The woman on the far right wears a black long-sleeve top and white pants. They maintain a steady pace, their arms swinging rhythmically as they run. The background features a cloudy sky and the distant horizon, with the water reflecting the muted tones of the sky. The scene remains consistent throughout the video, with no significant changes in the actions or appearance of the individuals or the environment.

prompt_en: The video opens in a professional kitchen, characterized by its stainless steel surfaces and modern appliances, including an industrial oven mounted above a stove. The chef, dressed in a black uniform with a yellow clip on the left sleeve, is positioned at the stove. In the first frame, he is about to open a bottle of olive oil, twisting the cap with his left hand, which he continues to hold throughout the video. The pot appears to be empty, and the chef seems to be preparing to add the olive oil. As the video progresses, the chef opens up the bottle of olive oil and pours it into the pot, carefully controlling the flow to ensure even distribution. The olive oil is poured steadily, filling the pot gradually. By the final frame, the pot contains a noticeable amount of olive oil, indicating the completion of this step in the cooking process. The chef's movements are deliberate and focused, showcasing his expertise in the kitchen. The background includes various kitchen tools and equipment, adding to the professional ambiance of the setting.

Bright fluorescent lights illuminate the room, casting a warm glow over the white-tiled floor. The walls are painted white with orange accents around a large window that lets in natural light. In the center of the room, a person dressed in black attire performs a series of rhythmic movements, possibly dancing or practicing a choreographed routine. They shift their weight from one foot to the other, occasionally raising their arms and gesturing expressively, appearing focused and engaged. Two tripods with cameras are set up to the left, capturing the performance, while a small black speaker is mounted on the wall to the right. A decorative lantern adds a touch of aesthetic detail. The room also features a low bench with orange and white stripes, positioned against the wall near the window, providing a seating area or resting spot. The overall scene remains consistent, with the person continuing their movements in the same location, maintaining the same level of engagement and focus.

prompt_en: A woman lies on her back on a yellow exercise mat placed on a polished wooden floor within a modern, well-lit living space. She is dressed in a dark blue long-sleeved top and black leggings, with white sneakers on her feet. Her curly hair is loose, cascading over her shoulders. She holds two small purple dumbbells, one in each hand, positioned near her chest. The room features large windows allowing natural light to stream in, revealing a view of greenery outside. A brown sofa with cushions, a small round table with a few items on it, and a tall, cylindrical white structure are visible in the background. The woman then lifts her legs straight up into the air while keeping her arms extended overhead, maintaining a straight line from her shoulders to her knees. After holding this position briefly, she slowly lowers her legs back down towards the mat, keeping them straight throughout the movement. By the final frame, she has completed the exercise, with her legs lowered and her arms still extended overhead, resting on the mat.  A top-down shot captures the woman performing a leg lift exercise with dumbbells, emphasizing her form and the movement against the backdrop of the modern living space.

A medium shot captures the subject from a slightly elevated perspective, emphasizing their composed stance and the details of their attire against the backdrop of the dimly lit field.

prompt_en: The video captures a thrilling moment during a volleyball match between Great Britain (GBR) and Bulgaria (BUL) at the London 2012 Olympics. Set indoors on a vibrant pink court bordered by a blue area, the scene is framed by red barriers adorned with the Olympic rings. The scoreboard indicates BUL leads GBR with a score of 1-4. Players from both teams are strategically positioned; the green team is on defense, while the white team prepares to serve. As the serve is made, the ball is hit over the net, and the green team dives to save it, successfully keeping it in play. The white team then readies themselves to continue the rally. The final frame shows the white team about to receive the ball from the green team, highlighting the dynamic and competitive nature of the match.

He is dressed in a white t-shirt with a graphic design and stands against a backdrop of dark brown wooden cabinets with silver handles. The countertop features a stainless steel kettle and an electric pressure cooker. The man is actively engaging with the banana, turning it slightly in his hands while speaking, likely explaining its characteristics or usage. The lighting highlights the warm tones of the kitchen and the vibrant yellow of the banana. The man maintains a steady position, focusing on the banana as the central element of the scene. The final frame shows the man continuing to hold the banana, gesturing with one hand while still looking at it, indicating an ongoing discussion or demonstration.

prompt_en: The video opens with a serene winter scene set on a frozen lake, surrounded by snow-covered trees under a pale blue sky. A man dressed in a red beanie, black jacket, scarf, and gloves stands on the ice, his body angled forward as if preparing to skate or balance. The background features a mix of evergreen and birch trees, their branches heavy with snow, creating a picturesque winter setting. The man appears poised and ready for action.  As the video progresses, a woman enters the frame from the left side, wearing a beige coat, blue jeans, white boots, and a blue beanie. She approaches the man, extending her arm towards him, seemingly to assist or guide him. The man, initially standing still, begins to move slightly, maintaining his balance. The woman then extends her leg behind her, lifting it high into the air, and leans back, her body forming an elegant arc. The man catches her, holding her close as she continues to balance on one leg, her arms wrapped around his neck. This interaction showcases a moment of playful support and coordination between the two individuals amidst the tranquil winter backdrop.  In the final frame, the man and woman are seen embracing closely, the woman's legs still elevated, demonstrating a sense of trust and connection. The serene winter landscape remains unchanged, with the snow-covered trees and pale blue sky providing a peaceful and picturesque setting for their interaction.

prompt_en: The video opens with a serene sunset scene, where a person stands silhouetted against a vibrant sky painted with hues of orange and pink. The individual, wearing reflective sunglasses and a dark jacket, is positioned near a window, gazing out over a cityscape. The city below features a mix of modern high-rise buildings with vehicles moving and lower residential structures with trees and streetlights scattered throughout. The camera pans towards the right, capturing the dynamic movement of the city below, including the flow of traffic and the gentle sway of trees. A prominent communication tower rises in the midground, adding to the urban landscape. The person then picks up a bottle of beer, bringing it to their lips and taking a sip, maintaining a relaxed posture as they enjoy the drink while continuing to look out at the picturesque view. The final frame captures this tranquil moment, with the person still holding the beer bottle, savoring the drink and the peaceful ambiance of the setting sun.

prompt_en: A snowboarder glides down a snowy slope next to a dense forest of snow-covered trees. The snowboarder maintains a balanced stance, with one foot slightly ahead of the other, as they move smoothly across the snow. The background features various snow-covered trees, creating a serene winter landscape. As the snowboarder continues their descent, they adjust their goggles with both hands. The camera follows the snowboarder closely, capturing their fluid movements against the backdrop of the snowy forest.

The scoreboard shows GS trailing SA 11-17 in the first quarter with 4:03 remaining. A technical foul has been called on Steve Kerr, the Warriors' head coach. The San Antonio Spurs logo is prominently displayed at center court, where players from both teams are strategically positioned. A player in a gray jersey dribbles the ball while being closely guarded by a player in a blue jersey, attempting to navigate past him. Other players from both teams are positioned around the perimeter, ready to react. The video highlights the dynamic movement of the players as they engage in the game, with the scoreboard updating slightly to reflect the Spurs' lead. The camera captures the intensity of the moment, focusing on the interaction between the two key players and the surrounding action on the court.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide shot of an indoor skatepark, where a large crowd of spectators lines the edges of the bowl-shaped skating area. The audience, dressed in casual attire, watches intently from behind safety railings. The roller skater, wearing a helmet and a loose-fitting blue jacket over a dark shirt, glides smoothly across the wooden surface of the bowl. Approaching the edge, the skater leans into the curve, executing a fluid turn and adjusting their stance to navigate the transition. They then accelerate down the slope, gaining momentum before performing a controlled jump, launching into the air with arms outstretched for balance. Mid-air, the skater maintains a crouched position, showcasing precision and skill. Upon landing, the roller skater continues to glide smoothly along the curved edge of the bowl, demonstrating agility and control throughout the sequence. The final frame captures the roller skater mid-landing, with their body positioned low and balanced, continuing their smooth glide along the bowl's edge.  A dynamic wide shot captures the skater's fluid movements and the engaged audience, emphasizing the energy and excitement of the scene.

prompt_en: The video opens in a well-lit indoor gymnasium-like area with a polished wooden floor marked for volleyball play. The walls are painted a light beige, featuring a few doors and windows, and a basketball hoop is visible on one side. The ceiling has recessed lighting, and a small section of the wall displays a flag. In the foreground, a woman stands ready to serve, holding a yellow and blue volleyball. She is dressed in a light gray long-sleeve t-shirt, dark shorts, and knee-high socks, with her hair tied back in a ponytail. In the background, several other individuals are scattered across the court; some are standing near the net, while others are further away, engaged in various activities. The woman raises the ball above her head, preparing to strike it as she raises her right hand, and then jumps in the air. The camera follows the ball's trajectory, capturing the dynamic motion without making any abrupt changes in its angle, and then follows the subsequent movement of the players. The video concludes with the ball and the woman in mid-air, while the players adjust their positions and a person wearing black attire on the other end of the net hits a ball swinging their right hand.  A medium shot captures the woman serving the volleyball, emphasizing her focused expression and athletic form. The camera smoothly tracks the ball's flight, highlighting the fluidity of the action. The background players are slightly out of focus, drawing attention to the main subject. The gym's warm lighting enhances the sense of energy and movement, creating a vivid depiction of a volleyball practice session.

prompt_en: A skier descends a snowy slope under a clear blue sky, their shadow stretching long across the pristine white snow. Dressed in dark winter gear and a helmet, the skier is positioned slightly off-center to the right, moving away from the camera. The skier maintains a steady pace, leaning slightly forward for balance, and occasionally adjusts their posture to navigate the terrain. To the left, a ski lift with red supports and cables ascends the hill, carrying a few passengers. Dense evergreen trees line both sides of the slope, their dark green foliage contrasting sharply with the bright snow. Rolling hills and mountains rise in the background, adding depth and a sense of vastness to the scene. The skier's shadow moves dynamically across the snow, reflecting their movement and the angle of the sun. The ski lift remains stationary in the background, with its cables stretching tautly above the slope. The surrounding forest of evergreen trees stands still, their branches swaying subtly in the breeze. The skier's descent is smooth, with occasional adjustments in posture to navigate the terrain. By the final frame, the skier has moved further down the slope, their shadow now more elongated due to the angle of the sun, while the ski lift and forest remain constant in the background.

prompt_en: The video opens in a well-lit indoor gymnasium with a polished wooden floor and cream-colored walls adorned with Olympic rings. A volleyball net is visible in the background, along with a row of benches and a small vent near the floor. Four players are present: a partially visible person with a grey shirt and black shorts, a male in black athletic wear with yellow shoes, a female in a gray long-sleeve shirt and dark shorts, and another male in black attire with blue accents on his sleeves. The male in black is positioned centrally, leaning forward with one leg extended and arms outstretched, seemingly preparing to dive for the volleyball. The female player stands further back, observing the play, while the third male player approaches from the right, also in a ready stance. As the sequence progresses, the male in black dives horizontally, extending his body low to the ground, reaching out with his hand towards the volleyball, which is captured mid-air above him. The female player remains stationary, watching the ball's trajectory, while the third male player continues to approach, maintaining his readiness. The final frame shows the male in black diving fully, his body stretched out horizontally, with the volleyball still in motion above him, highlighting the dynamic and athletic nature of the scene.

prompt_en: A dynamic video sequence set in a spacious indoor basketball court with a polished wooden floor marked for play. Large windows line the walls, allowing natural light to flood the space, and the ceiling features recessed lighting. A basketball hoop is mounted on the right side of the frame, with a net hanging from it. The backboard is partially visible, and the surrounding area includes padded walls and storage units. In the center of the court, a person dressed in a blue long-sleeve shirt and dark pants is holding a basketball, preparing to shoot. They take a few steps forward, raise their arm, and release the ball towards the hoop. The ball arcs through the air, heading towards the net. After the shot, the individual watches the ball's trajectory, then retrieves the ball and prepares for another attempt, repeating the process of dribbling, shooting, and observing the outcome. By the final frame, the person is seen walking away from the hoop, holding the basketball, and looking down at it, seemingly reflecting on their previous shot.  A medium shot captures the person's movements, emphasizing their actions and the surrounding environment. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the individual's interaction with the basketball and the hoop.

prompt_en: The video opens with a close-up shot of a small, round cake with white frosting, placed on a silver cake stand. The cake is beautifully decorated with sliced strawberries, kiwi, blueberries, and a sprig of mint on top. A person's hand, wearing a white sleeve, is seen sprinkling thin, slivered almonds over the side of the cake, adding a crunchy texture and visual appeal. The hand moves gracefully, carefully placing each almond slice, ensuring even coverage. The background is slightly blurred, showing a kitchen setting with a stove and some flowers, suggesting a homey atmosphere. The scene captures the meticulous process of decorating the cake, highlighting the contrast between the creamy white frosting and the vibrant fruit toppings. By the final frame, the cake is fully adorned with almonds, complementing the colorful fruit decorations, and the scene remains focused on the cake, showcasing the completed decoration.

prompt_en: A brightly lit, colorful kitchen setting showcases a person engaged in the process of decorating cupcakes. Dressed in a green long-sleeved shirt and a black and white patterned apron, the individual is meticulously arranging green cupcake liners on a white plate adorned with a gold doily. The scene includes a pink muffin tin filled with green cupcakes, a container of frosting, a small bowl of gold sprinkles, and a decorative plate with a shamrock design. The person picks up a green cupcake liner from the muffin tin and places it on the plate, continuing this action with another liner. The background features a pink and white kitchen-themed backdrop with a stove and cabinets, enhancing the cheerful ambiance. The video captures the careful and deliberate movements of the person as they organize the cupcakes, ensuring each liner is neatly positioned on the plate.

prompt_en: A close-up of a runner ascending a set of concrete stairs, captured with a dynamic lens flare effect. The runner is dressed in a patterned gray tank top, pink shorts, and black running shoes, with a red water bottle attached to their waistband. Their legs move rhythmically, propelling them forward as they climb the stairs bordered by a metal railing with horizontal bars. The background features a clear sky with a few distant buildings, indicating an urban setting. The sunlight creates a warm, lens-flare effect, adding a dynamic quality to the scene. The camera follows the runner's movement, capturing the fluid motion of their stride against the backdrop of the sunlit urban environment. The runner's form remains consistent throughout the sequence, emphasizing the effort and determination in their gait. By the final frame, the runner has reached the top of the stairs, continuing their run along the flat surface beyond, with the same warm, lens-flare lighting enhancing the overall scene.

prompt_en: The video opens with a scene from the NCAA Elite Eight basketball game between Texas Tech and Gonzaga, held at the Honda Center in Anaheim. The court prominently features the "March Madness" logo, signifying the tournament's stage. The scoreboard indicates that it is the first quarter with 19:58 remaining, and both teams have a score of 0. Players from Texas Tech, wearing red jerseys, and Gonzaga, in white jerseys, are positioned strategically across the court. A referee stands near the center, overseeing the game. As the video progresses, a player in a white jersey dribbles the ball down the court, maneuvering past defenders in red jerseys. The player in white advances towards the basket while the defense adjusts, preparing for a potential rebound or defensive play. The scoreboard updates slightly, reflecting the passage of time as the game continues. By the final frame, the player in white has moved closer to the basket, with the defense still actively engaged, and the game clock shows 19:52 remaining in the first quarter.  A dynamic medium shot captures the action, highlighting the player in white dribbling and the defensive maneuvers of the players in red. The camera angle shifts slightly to follow the movement of the ball, emphasizing the intensity of the game. The background shows the bustling crowd and the official signage indicating the event's significance. The overall scene conveys the competitive spirit and strategic gameplay typical of March Madness.

prompt_en: A dynamic action sequence unfolds in a spacious indoor gymnasium with high ceilings and large windows allowing ample natural light. The polished concrete floor reflects the ambient light, enhancing the industrial feel of the space. The walls are painted in a combination of white and muted tones, with sections featuring a textured, dark brown finish and a blue tone. On the left side, a yellow gymnastics apparatus, possibly a balance beam or uneven bars, stands upright against the wall. On the right side, clear backboards for basketball are mounted on pillars separating the windows.  The central figure is a woman dressed in black athletic wear, including a sports bra and leggings, with a visible sleeve tattoo on her right arm. She is engaged in a vigorous exercise routine, wearing a harness-like device around her waist, which is attached to two long, yellow fabric straps connected to a black tire. Her movements are fluid and continuous, transitioning from a crouched position to extended leg and arm movements. As the sequence progresses, she maintains a steady rhythm, with the tire following directly behind her. The overall scene remains consistent, with the woman's energetic actions being the primary focus against the static background of the gym.

prompt_en: A man on a sandy beach, shirtless and wearing gray shorts, performs a kettlebell exercise. Positioned near the shoreline, he bends over, lifting a blue kettlebell from the sand, showcasing his muscular physique and focused demeanor. The vast, calm turquoise ocean stretches out to the horizon under a clear blue sky, with a single seagull flying nearby, adding a dynamic element to the tranquil scene. The man transitions into an overhead press, raising the kettlebell above his head before lowering it back down to his shoulder level. The final frame captures him recovering from a lunge position, holding the kettlebell in front of him, indicating a continuation of his workout routine amidst the picturesque beach setting.

prompt_en: A dynamic soccer training session unfolds on a vibrant green field under a clear blue sky. The central figure, a player in a blue sports uniform with white socks and cleats, is captured mid-action, bending forward with hands on knees, likely performing a stretch or warm-up exercise. Surrounding this focal point, several other players in similar blue uniforms are scattered across the field, some standing still while others move subtly, contributing to the lively yet organized atmosphere. The background showcases a stadium with tiered seating, a prominent tall light pole, and a few trees lining the perimeter, adding depth to the scene. The video maintains a consistent and steady pace, emphasizing the continuous nature of the training session with minimal changes in the players' positions and actions.

prompt_en: A group of young people runs and skateboards through a dimly lit indoor corridor, their movements fluid and energetic. The walls are plain and show signs of wear, with some discoloration and minor damage. The floor is a smooth, polished surface, reflecting the overhead fluorescent lights that cast a cool, somewhat harsh glow. The ceiling is low, with a simple, rectangular light fixture illuminating the space. In the foreground, a person in a purple jacket and denim shorts is running, their legs moving quickly and their body leaning forward. Behind them, another individual in a white hoodie and pink shorts is also running, her hair bouncing with each step. Further back, a skateboarder in a blue shirt and black pants is crouched low on their board, gently weaving in and out. They run past a person standing still with their back to the wall. The camera follows from behind, capturing the fluid motion and the blurred background as the group moves deeper into the tunnel. The scene conveys a sense of urgency and energy, with the group navigating the space with ease and coordination. As the video progresses, the group continues their dynamic movement through the corridor, maintaining their pace and direction. The final frame shows the group still running and skateboarding, with the same individuals in the same positions, emphasizing the continuous and unbroken flow of their activity.

prompt_en: A cyclist rides down a quiet, tree-lined residential street, bathed in soft sunlight filtering through the leaves. The cyclist, wearing a bright yellow shirt, white pants, and a black helmet, pedals steadily along the paved road. The street is lined with parked cars on both sides, and low-rise buildings, possibly apartment complexes or townhouses, stand in the background. The cyclist's shadow stretches long on the road, adding depth to the tranquil scene. As the cyclist moves forward, a parked silver car slowly appears from the right, passing by without any interaction. The cyclist continues riding, maintaining a consistent pace, with the street remaining largely unchanged. The final frame captures the cyclist further down the street, the silver car having passed by, and the cyclist still riding away, the yellow shirt fluttering slightly in the breeze.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide aerial shot of an expansive ocean under a cloudy sky, creating a serene yet dynamic backdrop. The water is a deep, vibrant blue, with gentle waves rolling towards the shore. In the distance, three surfers are visible; one closer to the foreground and two further out, all waiting for the right wave. The closer surfer, wearing a dark wetsuit, is positioned on a surfboard, poised to catch an approaching wave. The wave itself is a striking shade of turquoise, breaking with white foam at its crest, suggesting it's a powerful but manageable size for surfing. As the video progresses, the closer surfer begins to paddle forward, gaining momentum as they approach the breaking wave. The wave rises steadily, curling over with increasing force. The surfer maintains balance, shifting their weight and adjusting their stance to ride the wave smoothly. The wave crests, and the surfer continues to maneuver skillfully along the face of the wave, showcasing their expertise and control. The other two surfers remain in the background, observing the action, while the ocean's vastness and the cloudy sky provide a dramatic setting for this surfing sequence. By the end of the video, the surfer is riding the wave with confidence, demonstrating a seamless blend of skill and harmony with the ocean's power.

The court prominently displays branding for Canton and Aeroflot, alongside the FIBA World Cup logo at center. Players from both teams are strategically positioned; Turkish players in white jerseys are actively dribbling and passing the ball, while Japanese players in black jerseys are defending. The scoreboard updates throughout the sequence, showing the score and time decreasing as the game progresses. The players' movements are fluid and intense, with Turkish players working to advance the ball while Japanese defenders adjust their stances to block or intercept. prompt_en: The video opens with a wide shot of a volleyball match at the London 2012 Olympics, taking place in a large indoor stadium packed with spectators. The court is a vibrant orange with clear white boundary lines, and the net divides the two teams, Brazil and the USA, distinguished by their dark and light uniforms respectively. The scoreboard above the court displays the current score: Brazil (BRA) leading 1-2 against the USA (USA) with a score of 4-2. Players from both teams are strategically positioned, ready for the next play. The USA team, in white, is seen preparing to serve, while the Brazilian team, in dark uniforms, stands in formation, anticipating the serve. As the serve is made, the USA team executes a powerful spike, sending the ball flying over the net. The Brazilian team dives and leaps in an attempt to block or retrieve the ball, showcasing the competitive nature of the match. The crowd watches intently, adding to the charged atmosphere of the game. By the final frame, the ball is in play, with players from both teams actively engaged in the rally, demonstrating the dynamic and fast-paced nature of the sport.

The background is filled with dense green trees, creating a serene and natural setting. As the sequence progresses, the man in the pink jersey raises his right hand, holding a small trophy, and his left arm rises as he celebrates his victory. Another individual with blonde hair, dressed in a dark-colored jersey, appears in the background, joining in the celebration. The man in the pink jersey continues to shake both arms in a triumphant gesture. As the scene unfolds, a group of individuals makes their way around the man, jumping and cheering joyously. The final frame captures the group of people celebrating enthusiastically, with the man in the pink jersey still holding the trophy high above his head, surrounded by his teammates who are laughing and cheering.

prompt_en: In a cozy kitchen setting, two individuals are engaged in preparing a dish involving a nori sheet and mashed avocado. One person, wearing a white shirt with "vegan" printed on it, holds a plate of chopped vegetables, including red bell peppers, purple onions, green bell peppers, and leafy greens. The other person, dressed in a black and white graphic t-shirt, uses a fork to spread mashed avocado evenly across the nori sheet placed on a white plate. The countertop features an open avocado half, a lemon cut into wedges, and a container of what appears to be a green substance, likely herbs or spices. The kitchen background includes various items such as a coffee maker, a bag labeled "Whole Foods," and other typical kitchen appliances. The person spreading the avocado continues their task, ensuring the avocado is distributed uniformly over the nori. The person holding the plate of vegetables occasionally reaches for the avocado half, indicating they may be planning to add more ingredients to the preparation. The scene remains focused on the food preparation process, with no significant changes in the environment or introduction of new objects. By the final frame, the person on the right has completed spreading the avocado, while the person on the left continues to hold the plate of vegetables, ready to incorporate them into the dish.

prompt_en: A woman is jogging along a paved path beside a calm body of water, likely a river or lake, under an overcast sky. She is dressed in athletic attire, wearing a pink long-sleeved top layered under a brown puffer vest, and has her hair tied back. Her expression is focused yet relaxed, suggesting she is enjoying her run. The background features a grassy embankment to her right, dotted with small trees and bushes, and a distant cityscape with tall buildings visible across the water. A few people can be seen walking or standing further down the path, adding a sense of scale and activity to the serene setting. As the woman continues her jog, her hair flows freely behind her, indicating the motion of running. Her pace remains steady, and her expression shifts subtly between moments of focus and slight smiles, reflecting her enjoyment of the activity. The background remains consistent, with the water, embankment, and city skyline providing a static backdrop that contrasts with her dynamic movement. By the final frame, the woman's determined yet content demeanor persists, capturing the essence of her active routine amidst a peaceful urban environment.

prompt_en: A dynamic judo session unfolds on a light yellow mat inside a dojo. Two individuals, both wearing gis—one white with blue accents and a black belt, the other blue—are engaged in a gripping maneuver. The man in white, positioned on top, leans forward, applying pressure on the opponent's back, who is hunched over on their knees, facing the ground. The person in blue struggles to maintain balance, trying to stabilize themselves amidst the intense grappling. As the sequence progresses, the man in white shifts his weight, adjusting his grip on the opponent's right arm, while the person in blue continues to roll and adjust their position. The video concludes with the man in white maintaining a dominant position, leaning forward and applying further pressure, while the person in blue rolls onto their back. The camera follows the action closely, capturing the fluid movements and expressions of the participants.

prompt_en: The video opens with a group of young men standing in lines on an indoor soccer field, all dressed in matching tracksuits. They are positioned in the center of the frame, facing slightly towards the camera, suggesting they are either preparing for a practice session or participating in a team activity. The setting is an expansive, well-lit indoor sports facility with a large, white, dome-like ceiling that creates a bright and open atmosphere. The turf of the field is a vibrant green, contrasting sharply with the white surroundings. In front of the players, a yellow agility ladder lies on the ground, indicating they might be about to engage in a training drill. The ladder remains in the same place for the duration of the video. The background reveals additional soccer goals and some scattered equipment, reinforcing the sports environment.  As the video progresses, each player at the front of the two lines begins to move, stepping forward and then running across the field. They appear to be demonstrating a movement or technique, possibly as part of a warm-up or agility drill. The rest of the players remain stationary, observing attentively. The scene continues to unfold with the players' dynamic movement, while the others maintain their positions, indicating a structured and organized training session. The camera angle shifts slightly throughout the video, capturing both wide shots of the entire group and closer views of individual players as they perform their movements. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the players and the vibrant green turf against the stark white backdrop of the dome ceiling.

prompt_en: The video opens with two women engaged in a stretching exercise outdoors at an outdoor gym. The woman on the left, dressed in a pink jacket and black leggings, is performing a high leg stretch, lifting her right leg straight up towards the sky. Her hair is tied back in a ponytail, and she smiles warmly at her companion. The woman on the right, wearing a gray hoodie and black leggings, assists by holding the raised leg steady with both hands, ensuring it remains straight. Her hair is also tied back in a ponytail, and she looks focused and supportive. The background features a dense green forest, indicating a park-like setting. The ground beneath them is covered with a dark, textured surface typical of outdoor exercise areas. In the distance, various pieces of black exercise equipment, including ladders and bars, are visible, suggesting this is a designated space for physical training. Throughout the video, the woman on the left continues to lift her leg higher, demonstrating increased flexibility and control. The woman on the right adjusts her grip slightly but remains steady, supporting the leg without any noticeable movement. The scene remains consistent, with both women focused on the stretching exercise, showcasing a dedicated and supportive interaction between them. By the final frame, the woman on the left has reached a higher position with her leg, indicating progress in the stretch, while the woman on the right continues to hold the leg firmly, ensuring safety and support. A medium shot captures their dynamic and supportive interaction.

prompt_en: The video opens with a man walking towards a metal railing that runs parallel to a brick wall, set against the backdrop of a large building with red brick and gray stone accents. The building features arched windows and a staircase leading up to it. The railing is supported by the brick wall, which is adorned with some graffiti. The ground below the railing is paved, and there are green bushes near the bottom right corner of the frame. The sky is clear and blue. As the sequence progresses, the man approaches the railing and engages in a dynamic movement. He climbs onto the railing, then lowers himself to hang from it. While hanging, he places his feet against the wall for support and jumps down onto a gray surface in front of the wall. After briefly landing, he jumps back toward the wall, grabbing the railing again. The camera captures his fluid motion, emphasizing the urban setting and the architectural details of the building. In the final frame, the man is seen holding onto the railing after jumping back, highlighting his interaction with the urban environment and the building's architectural elements.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a white blouse, standing on a wooden pier during late afternoon or early evening. She holds a smartphone in her right hand, seemingly taking a photo or recording a video of the scenic view. Her posture is relaxed, and she appears focused on her task. The pier stretches out over a calm ocean, with gentle waves lapping against the shore. In the background, a row of buildings, likely hotels or apartments, lines the coastline, interspersed with palm trees swaying gently in the breeze. The sky above is a soft gradient of pink and purple hues, suggesting the sun is setting. Other people are visible on the pier; one person bends down, possibly picking something up or adjusting their belongings. The woman continues to hold her phone steady, occasionally adjusting her grip to capture different angles of the picturesque view. The other individuals move slowly, some walking towards the camera while others remain stationary, taking in the serene environment. The overall atmosphere remains tranquil and leisurely, with the warm lighting and the gentle waves contributing to the peaceful ambiance. By the final frame, the woman is still engaged with her smartphone, maintaining her position on the pier. The scene remains largely unchanged, with the same people and elements present, but the subtle movements of the individuals in the background suggest a continuous flow of activity.

prompt_en: The video opens in a well-lit judo dojo, characterized by large windows that allow natural light to enter. The walls are a soft beige, decorated with framed pictures and papers pinned to boards. Two men wearing white gis sit side-by-side with their backs leaning against the wall in the background. In the foreground, two individuals are engaged in a judo practice session. The person on the left, dressed in a blue gi with a black belt, is actively grappling with the person on the right, who wears a white gi with a black belt. The individual in blue grips the arm of the person in white, initiating a throw. The person in white responds by lifting their right leg, preparing for a counter-throw. The sequence continues with the individual in blue getting lifted off the ground, going over the person in white. This results in both participants landing on the mat with their backs towards the floor while still holding onto each other's arm sleeves. The video concludes with the two men in white gis no longer visible in the background.

prompt_en: The video opens with a scene set in an indoor tennis court named "Sport Palace," as indicated by the large cursive text on the wall. The court has a reddish-brown clay surface marked with white lines for boundaries. A player dressed in a white shirt and black shorts stands near the net, holding a tennis racket, while another player in red attire is positioned further back on the opposite side of the net. The ceiling features a high, arched structure with visible beams and supports, allowing some natural light to filter through, creating a bright and open atmosphere.  As the sequence progresses, the player in the foreground, wearing a white shirt and black shorts, is seen preparing to hit the ball. Initially, he holds his racket with both hands, focusing intently on the approaching tennis ball. He then shifts his weight slightly forward, bringing the racket into a ready position for a forehand swing. The ball is in mid-air, heading towards him, and he executes the swing, making contact with the ball. His body follows through with the motion, completing the stroke. The opponent, dressed in red, remains stationary, observing the play. By the final frame, the player in the foreground has completed his swing, and the ball is seen flying across the net towards the opponent. The opponent, positioned near the net, is ready to return the shot. The scene captures the dynamic movement and focus of the players during the tennis match, emphasizing the intensity and precision of the sport.

prompt_en: The video opens with a lively scene of a soccer match taking place on a well-maintained artificial turf field within a community park. The field is surrounded by a chain-link fence, beyond which several banners advertise local businesses such as "CHICKS LUMBER COMPANY" and "CHEESE DIP." The backdrop includes a multi-story building with a brick facade and a covered pavilion, suggesting a public or recreational area. Trees line the perimeter, and a playground with slides and swings is visible in the distance. In the foreground, four players are actively engaged in the game. Two players, one in a dark blue jersey with the number 19 and another in a red shirt, are competing for control of the ball. The player in the red shirt is leaning forward, extending his leg to intercept or challenge the ball, while the player in the blue jersey is positioned to the side, seemingly preparing to defend or counterattack. A third player, wearing a white shirt with pink accents, is also involved in the play, moving dynamically to assist or block. The ball is in motion, changing speed, rolling across the field as the players adjust their stances. The camera pans to the right, capturing the dynamic movement of the players and the ball. In the background, several spectators are seated on the ground, watching the game attentively. Some individuals are standing, observing the match from a closer proximity. The overall atmosphere suggests a casual, friendly game, possibly among friends or neighbors. The scene captures the essence of community sports, with participants and onlookers enjoying the activity in a relaxed environment.

prompt_en: The video opens with a winter scene at a ski resort, showcasing a skier dressed in winter gear gliding down a snow-covered slope under a bright, clear blue sky. The sun is positioned directly in front of the camera, casting a radiant glow over the scene. In the background, a chairlift system with multiple empty seats is suspended by cables, stretching across the sky. The skier approaches the camera, changes direction abruptly, slowing down and stopping. This action creates a cloud of snow that approaches the camera, gradually obscuring the view with snowflakes and spray filling the air. As the cloud clears, the skier stands upright, holding ski poles, and appears ready to continue their descent. The final frame captures the skier silhouetted against the bright sunlight, with the remnants of the snow cloud obscuring the camera frame on the right side.

The man begins by raising his fists, then transitions into a series of punches, alternating between jabs and uppercuts. His movements are fluid and precise, showcasing his focus and skill. As the sequence progresses, he continues to practice his punches, maintaining a steady rhythm and demonstrating various offensive maneuvers. By the final frame, the man remains engaged in his boxing routine, highlighting his technique and determination within the ring.

The boy with curly hair, wearing a white t-shirt, is holding a dark mug near his right ear, appearing to listen intently. To his right, the girl with braided hair tied with a red hair tie, wearing a white and pink top, holds a partially eaten slice of bread topped with white spread and two red items. The kitchen counter is adorned with a bowl of cereal, a glass bottle, and a white mug. An adult in a pink shirt is partially visible on the left side of the frame. As the video progresses, a woman in a brown shirt and blue nail polish enters from the right, gently touching the girl’s right shoulder and right cheek before kissing her left cheek. The final frame captures the girl smiling warmly, while the boy continues to hold the mug.

prompt_en: The video opens with a close-up of a wooden kitchen counter where two individuals are engaged in preparing dough. The person on the left, wearing a black chef's jacket with "SORTED" embroidered on it, is actively shaping a ball of dough by rolling it between their palms. The counter is lightly dusted with flour, and a glass bowl containing more dough remnants is positioned to the right. A rolling pin rests on the right side of the counter. In the background, a white cabinet with silver handles is visible, along with various kitchen items including a blender, jars, and a small plant. The scene suggests a cooking demonstration or tutorial. As the video progresses, the individual in the chef's jacket continues to flatten the dough, pressing it down gently with both hands. The person on the right, dressed in a dark shirt, stands beside them, observing closely. The flour on the counter remains spread out, and the glass bowl with dough remnants stays in place. The rolling pin remains untouched on the counter throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the individual in the chef's jacket has successfully flattened the dough into a disk, while the person in the dark shirt continues to watch attentively. The scene maintains its focus on the preparation process, with the kitchen setting remaining consistent and the individuals engaged in their task.

prompt_en: A dynamic sports video captures a man running energetically across a well-maintained soccer field under a clear blue sky. Dressed in a red long-sleeve shirt and patterned shorts featuring red, white, and blue stripes, complemented by black athletic shoes, he showcases his athletic form as he moves swiftly across the field. The field is marked with white boundary lines, and in the background, a chain-link fence encloses the area, beyond which stand tall trees and a few residential houses. The man's run is focused and powerful, transitioning into a more dynamic movement as he bends his knees and shifts his weight forward, touching the ground with his right hand, suggesting preparation for a sprint or a change of direction. The camera captures this transition smoothly, emphasizing his agility and speed. The final frame shows the man mid-stride, his body leaning forward in anticipation, with the field and distant scenery still visible behind him.

prompt_en: The video opens with a close-up shot of a granite countertop in a cozy kitchen or bar setting. A clear glass pitcher with a diamond-cut pattern is prominently placed on the counter. To the left, a bottle with an orange label and a green bottle are visible, suggesting the presence of beverages. A metal stirrer lies nearby. The background features wooden cabinets, adding warmth to the scene. A hand, clad in a dark sweater and adorned with a gold ring, enters the frame and begins pouring a clear liquid from a smaller glass container into the pitcher. The liquid flows steadily until the pitcher is partially filled. The hand then moves out of the frame, leaving the pitcher with the liquid inside. The final frame captures the hand still in motion, having just completed the pour, with the pitcher now containing the liquid. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the action of pouring and the details of the pitcher and countertop.

prompt_en: A vibrant dance performance unfolds within a traditional African-style building, characterized by its thatched roof and walls adorned with geometric patterns. Five dancers, each wearing a brightly colored jumpsuit and helmet, execute a synchronized routine with precision and energy. The second dancer from the left stands out in a shirtless state, wearing red pants and a red helmet, while the others mirror his movements with three in blue jumpsuits and helmets, and one in a pink jumpsuit and helmet. In the background, four individuals on a raised platform observe the performance, enhancing the cultural ambiance. Natural light streams through an open doorway at the back, illuminating the dancers' vivid costumes against the earthy tones of the interior. As the sequence progresses, a person in white attire walks past the dancers, introducing a subtle change to the scene. The dancers continue their energetic and coordinated movements, showcasing a lively and culturally rich performance.

prompt_en: A dynamic action sequence in a gymnasium setting, capturing a woman playing badminton. The scene unfolds on a red court marked with white lines, typical of a badminton playing area. The ceiling features exposed red metal beams and fluorescent lighting fixtures, creating a bright and industrial atmosphere. The walls are a muted gray, and there are no visible windows, indicating an enclosed space. The woman is dressed in athletic attire, including a navy blue sports top with purple accents and a matching skirt, paired with red sneakers. She holds a badminton racket in her right hand, poised to strike, while her left arm is slightly extended for balance. The sequence begins with her in a ready stance, preparing to hit the shuttlecock. She then raises her right arm, with racket above her head, executing a powerful overhead smash. Her body shifts dynamically, showcasing agility and precision. After completing the shot, she lowers her racket and appears to be observing the trajectory of the shuttlecock, possibly anticipating the next move in the game. The final frame captures her in mid-action, having just completed her overhead smash, with her racket lowered and her gaze directed towards the shuttlecock's flight path.

Across the river, a cityscape unfolds, featuring a mix of modern high-rise buildings, including one with a distinctive curved glass facade and another with a sleek, cylindrical design. The sky above is clear and bright, indicating a sunny day. The woman is dressed in athletic attire, including a patterned tank top, pink shorts, and running shoes, and she carries a red device, likely a fitness tracker or phone holder, on her wrist. As she jogs, the camera pans to follow her movement, capturing her from different angles as she passes by the railing and the city skyline. The scene remains vibrant and dynamic throughout, highlighting her continuous motion against the backdrop of the urban landscape.

prompt_en: The video captures a volleyball match between Thailand (THA) and Peru (PER), with the score displayed as THA 2-2 and PER 0-1. Set in an indoor stadium with red seats partially filled with spectators, the scene features a blue and green playing surface marked with standard volleyball lines. Teams are positioned on opposite sides of the net; the Thai team wears dark uniforms, while the Peruvian team wears white. Advertisements for sponsors like Mikasa and Japanet line the court's perimeter. As the video progresses, a player from the Thai team serves the ball, sending it over the net. The Peruvian team responds with defensive maneuvers, attempting to block or return the serve. The camera follows the ball's trajectory, capturing the dynamic movement of players as they react to the serve. The final frame shows the Peruvian team in motion, ready to counter the serve, with the Thai team positioned to receive the ball.

prompt_en: A dynamic volleyball match unfolds in a large indoor stadium filled with enthusiastic spectators. The brightly lit court is marked clearly for play, with the team in red uniforms on one side and the team in white uniforms on the other. The scoreboard shows Japan leading Canada 8-5 in the second set. Players in red are actively engaged, preparing to receive the serve from the white team. As the serve is made, player number 12 from the white team successfully sends the ball over the net. The red team quickly responds, with players positioning themselves to either block or set up for a counterattack. The crowd in the background is visibly engaged, adding to the lively atmosphere of the match. The video concludes with the players in white executing a strategic play, with one player jumping to spike the ball while others prepare to defend or support their teammates. The camera captures the intensity and excitement of the game from a mid-range perspective, highlighting the players' movements and the energetic crowd.

prompt_en: The video opens with a close-up of a rectangular baking pan filled with a rich, dark brown batter, likely chocolate-based, with visible specks of nuts or chocolate chips. The surface of the batter is glossy and slightly uneven, indicating its moist and dense texture. A hand enters the frame from the upper right corner, holding a spoon or spatula, and begins to spread a light brown, creamy substance, possibly peanut butter or caramel, across the top of the batter. The hand moves methodically, creating a decorative zigzag pattern by drizzling the substance in a series of curved lines. The hand continues to add more of the spread, gradually covering more of the pan's surface, while the camera remains focused on the pan, capturing the contrast between the dark batter and the lighter spread. The video concludes with the pan almost entirely covered by the creamy substance, forming a visually appealing and textured layer on top of the batter.

prompt_en: The video opens with a man standing outdoors in front of a modern building characterized by its clean lines and a combination of white and blue panels. The sky above is a clear, vibrant blue, indicating a sunny day. The man, dressed in a white hoodie and gray athletic pants, stands with earphones in his ears, appearing focused and ready for physical activity. As the video progresses, he transitions from standing on both feet to extending one leg up on the railing. He places his left hand under his thigh, aiding in maintaining balance and stability during the stretch. The background remains consistent throughout, showcasing the same modern building and clear sky. By the final frame, the man continues his stretch with one leg extended and the other not visible, demonstrating a deliberate and controlled movement aimed at flexibility and preparation for exercise. A medium shot captures the man's focused and dynamic posture against the backdrop of the modern building and clear blue sky.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a person wearing a gray and white patterned sweater, skillfully juggling three multicolored balls against a backdrop of vibrant autumn foliage. The individual's hands move fluidly, tossing the balls in a continuous juggling routine. The first ball is seen in the air in the person's right hand, while the second and third balls are closer to their hands. As the sequence progresses, the first ball reappears in various positions above the person's hands, and the second and third balls are caught and thrown back into the air. The person's hands maintain a steady rhythm, ensuring the balls remain in motion. The autumn leaves in the background add a warm, seasonal touch to the dynamic performance.

A small wooden structure, possibly a kiosk or information booth, is situated near one of the trees, adding a quaint charm to the setting. Several people are scattered across the park, some walking leisurely while others appear to be engaged in conversation or enjoying the surroundings. In the foreground, a man in a blue jacket and white pants is seen walking towards the camera, holding something to his ear, perhaps a phone or a device. He is followed by a woman in a blue coat and black pants, also walking purposefully. Further back, a group of people, including children, is gathered near the wooden structure, seemingly interacting or observing something of interest.
